Zhang Xian smiled and returned the courtesy.
"Uncle, I'm here to see Qingqing."
Hearing "Qingqing," Yun Qi shuddered visibly, looking nauseated.
Yun He gave a knowing, ambiguous smile, nodding repeatedly.
"Qingqing is waiting for you inside!
He then turned and shot Yun Qi a meaningful look, raising his voice theatrically.
"Qi'er!
Didn't you say there's an important merchant association banquet tonight?
It's getting late.
We should hurry!"
What banquet?
Since when do I know about this?
Yun Qi was stunned for a moment before the realization hit him.
Damn it!
This is just an excuse to kick us out and make room for Zhang Xian and Yun Wanqing!
This is utterly unreasonable!
"Ah... right, right!
The banquet!
They're just waiting for us.
Let's go," Yun Qi complained internally but played along helplessly.
Seeing his future father-in-law and big nephew being so accommodating, Zhang Xian was immensely pleased.
He immediately retrieved a fiery-red greatcoat from his storage ring and handed it to Yun He.
"Uncle, wait a moment.
A small token of my appreciation for your trouble."
Yun He’s eyes lit up.
A Fire-attribute defensive Spirit Treasure?
Forgetting all pretense of restraint, he grabbed the coat.
It felt warm and smooth to the touch, with spiritual light shimmering within.
He grinned so wide his face nearly split.
"Aiyaya!
Son-in-law, you're too kind!
Too kind!"
Zhang Xian then looked at the aggrieved Yun Qi.
Thinking that the guy had technically become his junior, he ought to compensate him a bit.
He took out a slender, Fire-attribute Spirit Sword.
"Here!
Big nephew, this longsword is for you.
Speaking of which, if it weren't for you playing matchmaker back then, Qingqing and I might never have met."
Who the hell played matchmaker?!
But looking at the Spirit Treasure sword being offered, feeling its pure fire spiritual power and sharp aura, Yun Qi’s indignation vanished.
He quickly accepted it, caressing the blade lovingly.
Dignity is cheap.
Spirit Treasures are forever.
Watching from the side, Yun He beamed, then immediately put on a stern face to lecture.
"Qi'er!
Hurry up and thank your uncle!"
Yun Qi held the sword, looked at Zhang Xian’s youthful face, and felt the words "Thank you, Uncle" stuck in his throat like a fishbone.
His face flushed bright red.
It took him a long, painful moment to squeeze two words out from between his teeth.
"Thank you!"
Zhang Xian laughed heartily and patted his shoulder.
"Forget it, forget it.
Big nephew isn't used to it yet.
Once Qingqing and I are formally married, you can change how you address me then!"
He delayed no further, gave a cupped-hand salute to the two, turned, and pushed open the door to Yun Wanqing’s inner chamber.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 The Mood Was Set So Perfectly
paragraphs: As Zhang Xian vanished behind the door, Yun He and Yun Qi stood outside the villa, exchanging bewildered glances in the cooling evening air.
"Where do we go now?" Yun Qi clutched his newly acquired Spirit Sword against his chest, confusion etched on his face.
Yun He stroked his beard, looking equally awkward. "Uh, well... how should I know? Let's just find somewhere to kill time. We'll come back tomorrow afternoon."
Yun Qi’s indignation flared. "I am the Grand Commander of the Cloud Raiment Pavilion's Inner Sanctum! Am I to be reduced to wandering the streets like a vagrant?"
Yun He sighed. He ran a hand over the smooth, warm surface of his brand-new Fire Spirit Treasure cloak, then glanced at the high-grade sword in his grandson's arms.
"Forget it, forget it," the old fox muttered, his eyes gleaming. "For Qingqing's happiness—and for these two treasures—this small sacrifice is nothing."

A sudden, lecherous glint sparked in Yun He’s eyes. "Then... shall we secure a VIP suite at the Pitying Fragrance Pavilion? I hear their... 'fine wine' is exceptionally full-bodied this time of year."
Yun Qi’s eyes lit up. "Excellent idea, Grandfather!!"
Inside the inner chamber, Yun Wanqing sat by the window, her cheeks burning. She had witnessed her father and nephew’s exaggerated exit performance and felt thoroughly humiliated.
When Zhang Xian pushed the door open, she shot him a reproachful glare. "What do you think you're doing here?"
Zhang Xian approached, noting her flushed skin and evasive eyes. His father-in-law’s heavy-handed assist had been remarkably effective.

He glanced out the window, teasing her with a grin. "Father-in-law is certainly thoughtful. He dismissed the guards and maids, leaving us plenty of private space. judging by their haste, they probably won't be back tonight."
Yun Wanqing’s face turned even redder, resembling a ripe apple. "Y-you're talking nonsense! The finals are in two days. Shouldn't you be in seclusion preparing? Why did you come here looking for me?"
The playful expression on Zhang Xian’s face faded, replaced by a solemn tenderness. He gently took Yun Wanqing’s slightly cool hand and carefully placed a jade box into her palm.
Even through the seal, the box emanated an aura of primordial chaos.
"I came to deliver the medicine."
Yun Wanqing trembled. Her gaze locked onto the jade box. The vast, life-infused aura radiating from within told her exactly what it was.
The Creation Immortal Pill.
The cure for her daughter, Yun Zhen'er. The solution to the soul deficiency that had plagued her child since birth.
Centuries of longing, anxiety, and countless moments of despair transformed into a surging torrent of emotion. Tears, like broken strings of pearls, poured from her eyes without warning.
She looked up at Zhang Xian, her gaze overflowing with ecstasy, gratitude, and an indescribable affection.
"Zhang Xian!"
She choked out his name, unable to control herself any longer. She threw herself into his arms, her embrace tight and desperate, as if she wanted to melt into his very bones.
[Ding! Current Favorability: 73]
[Ding! Gift of Creation Immortal Pill successful. Triggered return. Returned: Primordial Creation Pill x10]

[Primordial Creation Pill: Peak Earth-Grade elixir. Can repair shattered Golden Cores, recondense dispersed Nascent Souls, and reverse bodily collapse. Also activates and repairs meridians and spiritual roots. A legendary treasure for defying fate and rebuilding one's Dao foundation.]
The System prompt was like a choir of angels in his mind. Zhang Xian was ecstatic. Peak Earth-Grade. Capable of healing a shattered foundation.
Excitedly, he cupped Yun Wanqing’s tear-streaked face and planted several fervent kisses on her cheeks, finally pressing a deep, passionate one onto her soft lips.
His voice carried a barely suppressed trembling. "Wanqing, you're truly my lucky star! I love you to death!"

Yun Wanqing was overwhelmed by his sudden passion. Why does he seem even happier than I am? But her heart swelled with sweetness. She responded with equal fervor, her body growing warm and pliable against him, her gaze turning hazy with desire.
Just as the atmosphere in the room was about to reach a boiling point, Zhang Xian suddenly stopped.
He held Yun Wanqing by the shoulders, pushing her back slightly. His eyes were bright, but they held a look of impatience rather than lust.

"Wanqing," he said with deadly seriousness. "The pill is delivered. I need to hurry back to seclusion to prepare for the battle. My final opponent is Long Zhi; I can't be careless. I'll come find you again after the competition!"
With that, he turned on his heel to leave.
"Huh?"
Yun Wanqing stood frozen, dumbfounded. The mood was set perfectly... the candles were metaphorically lit... and after a few kisses, he was bolting? What kind of logic was this?
Seeing her stunned expression, Zhang Xian paused, as if remembering something trivial. "Oh, right!"
He pulled out a damaged black wooden doll and stuffed it into her hand.

"This is the substitute death puppet Yang Poxiao left behind yesterday. It's broken, but the material and runes are quite peculiar. You have wide connections and know many experts. Help me study it, see if there's anything mysterious about it."
Yun Wanqing subconsciously took the doll, still suffering from emotional whiplash. "Oh."
[Ding! Gift of Damaged Nine Nether Tribulation Puppet successful. Triggered return. Returned: Nine Nether Tribulation Puppet x10]

[Nine Nether Tribulation Puppet: Earth-Grade secret treasure. After refining, can substitute for the host's death once and teleport the host to a random safe location. Note: Substitution fails if damage exceeds the puppet's limit.]
[Special Note: It is recommended the host commit suicide to achieve the safest escape effect.]
Holy crap, another massive win.
Looking at Yun Wanqing’s dazed, adorable appearance, Zhang Xian couldn't resist. He leaned in and gave her smooth forehead another loud, smacking kiss.
"I'm off! Get ready to be my bride, hahaha!"
With a hearty laugh, he strode out of the room, his white robes fluttering as he vanished into the night, leaving behind a dashing silhouette.
Yun Wanqing stood alone in the silence.

She held the warm jade box in one hand and the cold, broken puppet in the other. Her heart was a chaotic mix of joy, gratitude, and an indescribable sense of loss. She felt torn between laughing and crying.
She had finally mustered her courage, prepared herself mentally, and was ready to give herself to him completely. And he just... left?
She lowered her head to look at the immortal pill, then touched her kissed cheek. Finally, she let out a helpless sigh, though the corners of her mouth curled upward.
"He's actually a true gentleman," she murmured softly, a gentle smile blooming.
The rumors about him being a lecherous fiend were clearly false. It was just that this "gentleman" was completely clueless about romance, which made her feel both amused and a little frustrated.
Zhang Xian hurried back to the Yunmiao Sect villa. Barely half an hour had passed since he left.
He went straight to the side room where Li Fuxi was recuperating and gently knocked on the door.
"Don't come in!" Lin Yinyin’s haughty voice rang out instantly.
Zhang Xian pushed the door open anyway. A faint scent of medicinal herbs lingered in the air.

Li Fuxi was half-reclining on a soft couch by the window. Her face was still pale, but her spirit seemed somewhat recovered. Lin Yinyin, acting like a protective mother hen, had pulled a chair right up to the couch and was sitting guard.
Seeing Zhang Xian enter, Lin Yinyin immediately snapped her head toward the window, letting out a crisp, audible "Hmph!"
Li Fuxi lifted her eyelids slightly. Her gaze lingered on Zhang Xian for a fleeting second before dropping back to her clasped hands.
She said nothing. But her silence felt heavier and more suffocating than any accusation.
Zhang Xian rubbed his nose, sensing the danger in the air. It seems I've knocked over not one, but two vinegar jars.

chapters.title: Chapter 132 Isn’t Teacher-Disciple Even More Exciting
paragraphs: Zhang Xian stood by the bedside, his gaze tracing the haggard lines of Li Fuxi’s face. Even in her weakened state, her beauty remained, though it was now cast in a pale, fragile light.
"Master," he asked, his voice low and laced with concern. "How are you feeling?"

Li Fuxi kept her head bowed, refusing to meet his eyes. "It is of no consequence. My Golden Core is shattered, yes, but the foundation remains. I can barely maintain the seventh stage of the Golden Core realm."
She let out a soft, self-deprecating sigh. "I simply must avoid combat in the future. At the very least, I can still stand guard over Spirit Sword Peak."

"Exactly!" Lin Yinyin chimed in instantly, moving to shield her master with desperate enthusiasm. "Master has me! I’ll work twice as hard these next few years. I’ll claw my way up to become an Inspector or something high-ranking. We’ll make Spirit Sword Peak flourish together. You won’t need to worry about a single thing."

She shot Zhang Xian a glare sharp enough to draw blood. "And some people should go keep their fiancée company. We master and disciple will depart for the sect tomorrow. We wouldn't want to be eyesores here."
Zhang Xian looked at the two jealous women before him, feeling a strange mix of amusement and helplessness. The air in the room was thick enough to choke on.
Having reaped enormous gains today, his spirits were high. Seeing his master’s fragility beneath her forced composure, and Yinyin’s bristling, protective cuteness, felt incredibly vivid.

He stepped forward, closing the distance to the soft couch until he loomed over it. He leaned down, his burning gaze locking onto Li Fuxi’s downcast eyes. A bright, slightly roguish smile curled his lips.
"Master..."
Li Fuxi’s heart fluttered at the sudden proximity. Instinctively, she looked up.
"I’m afraid I have to disappoint you again," Zhang Xian said, laughter dancing in his tone. "You want to run? Not a chance."
Li Fuxi stared at his radiant smile, momentarily dazed.

Zhang Xian didn’t waste words. He took Li Fuxi’s hand and pressed a pill into her palm. It swirled with profound, mysterious light, and the moment it appeared, the spiritual energy in the room stirred, emitting a faint, resonant hum.
Lin Yinyin instantly forgot her anger. Her eyes went round as saucers. "Th-this... is this the Creation Immortal Pill?"
Li Fuxi’s gaze was glued to her palm. She recognized instantly that the aura of this pill far surpassed anything ordinary. But just as quickly, the light in her eyes dimmed.
She slowly shook her head; her voice trembled with resolve. "I cannot accept this."
She tried to pull her hand away. "You promised Pavilion Master Yun in front of everyone in the main hall. You cannot go back on your word. This pill rightfully belongs to her."
Her voice dropped, tinged with weary resignation. "Besides, I am truly tired. After this incident, I will not act recklessly again. It would be a waste on me."

"That won’t do," Zhang Xian cut her off decisively. His tone left no room for argument. "My goal is to nurture you to Nascent Soul, Soul Formation, and even higher realms! What is a shattered spiritual root or a cracked Golden Core to me?"
He leaned closer, his presence overwhelming. "You shatter it once, I’ll fix it once. You shatter it a thousand times, I’ll mend it a thousand times!"
As he spoke, he shot a glance at Lin Yinyin, who was watching with bated breath.
The girl understood immediately. She nimbly grabbed her small stool and scooted to the far side of the room, mouthing a silent "Go for it!" to Zhang Xian.
Zhang Xian sat on the edge of the couch. He leaned forward until he was almost nose-to-nose with Li Fuxi, studying her flushed cheeks and evasive eyes.

"Regarding Pavilion Master Yun, I have my own plans," he murmured. "This pill was prepared specifically for you. Did you think you could repay your debt on the arena stage? Master, you’re thinking too simply."
"I—" Li Fuxi, flustered by his heat, tried to retort.
Her wrist was suddenly seized by Zhang Xian’s warm, powerful hand.
"Mmph!"
Before she could react, Zhang Xian’s other hand gently pinched her chin. His cool fingertips exerted an irresistible force, prying her mouth open slightly.
In the next second, the pill, radiating immense vitality, was dropped precisely past her lips.
The elixir melted the instant it touched her tongue, transforming into a torrent of warmth that surged down her throat.

"Zhang Xian! What are you doing?!" Li Fuxi cried out, half in shame, half in anger. Her almond eyes went wide as she tried to struggle against his grip. "Even if you don’t give this to Yun Wanqing, you should keep it for yourself! It could resolve your False Core issue! It could let you advance!"
Zhang Xian held her hand tighter. He spoke over her panic, his voice low, clear, and carrying a terrifying seriousness.
"Li Fuxi. Be my woman."
The words exploded in Li Fuxi’s mind like a thunderclap from a clear sky.
All her struggles, her shame, her anger, and her reason were blasted to dust in that instant. Her cheeks ignited, flushing a deep, alluring crimson.
[Ding! Current Favorability: 74.]
[Ding! Gift of Primordial Creation Pill successful. Triggered return: Primordial Creation Pill x100.]

[Primordial Creation Pill: Peak Earth-grade. Heals shattered Golden Cores and dispersed Nascent Souls; reverses foundation collapse. Activates and repairs meridians and spiritual roots. A legendary treasure that defies fate to reshape the Dao Foundation.]
"You... what nonsense are you spouting?!" Li Fuxi stammered, her composure shattering. "I... I am your master! This... this is unacceptable!"
Zhang Xian, seeing her flustered state, smiled deeply. Like a magician, he produced a few books from his spatial storage.
The covers were garish and unmistakable: Help, My Yandere Master Fell for Me and The Legend of the Condor Heroes. He waved them before her eyes.
"Master quite enjoys reading these, doesn’t she? What’s the matter?" He leaned in to whisper, "Isn't the teacher-disciple dynamic even more exciting?"
"You... you..."
Li Fuxi stared at the mortifying titles. A rush of blood surged to her head, making her dizzy. She wished the floor would crack open and swallow her whole.
That wretched disciple! How did he know? And to bring them out now?
However, her indignant rebuke was choked off by a sudden, explosive surge of medicinal power erupting within her body.
"Mmph!" Li Fuxi grunted, her eyes flying wide open.

The pill transformed into tidal waves of warm energy. Her damaged meridians were rapidly repaired, forced open, and widened. Her shattered, dim Golden Core and dual spiritual roots began to glow like stars. Slowly, they began to rotate and coalesce, following a profound, mystical trajectory.
The sheer volume of power, the exquisite precision of the repair—it was overwhelming. This effect was terrifyingly potent, surpassing the Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed by magnitudes.
She could sense the repaired Golden Core possessed a spiritual essence purer and more powerful than her original one.
This is definitely not the Creation Immortal Pill.
A storm of shock raged in Li Fuxi’s heart. She looked sharply at Zhang Xian, her eyes filled with astonishment, confusion, and an inexpressible surge of gratitude.
This heaven-defying medicine could have resolved his False Core issue. It could have let him be reborn. And he gave it to her without a second thought?
Zhang Xian seemed to see through her turmoil. He gently patted the back of her hand, his voice soft yet firm.
"Master, rest assured. I have more where that came from. Just focus on your recovery. Yinyin and I will come see you again tomorrow."
Li Fuxi looked at him, a thousand words stuck in her throat. In the end, she could only manage a soft, trembling sound.
"Mmm."

She slowly closed her eyes, concentrating fully on guiding the vast medicinal power. Unlike last time, the joy of restoring her cultivation was drowned out by another emotion—something more turbulent, and infinitely sweeter.
Zhang Xian slowly stood up. He gave a meaningful look to the dumbfounded Lin Yinyin.
The two of them quietly tiptoed out of the room, leaving the master to her healing.

"Regarding Pavilion Master Yun, I have my own plans," he murmured.
"This pill was prepared specifically for you.
Did you think you could repay your debt on the arena stage?
Master, you’re thinking too simply."
"I—" Li Fuxi, flustered by his heat, tried to retort.
Her wrist was suddenly seized by Zhang Xian’s warm, powerful hand.
"Mmph!"
Before she could react, Zhang Xian’s other hand gently pinched her chin.
His cool fingertips exerted an irresistible force, prying her mouth open slightly.
In the next second, the pill, radiating immense vitality, was dropped precisely past her lips.
The elixir melted the instant it touched her tongue, transforming into a torrent of warmth that surged down her throat.
"Zhang Xian!
What are you doing?!" Li Fuxi cried out, half in shame, half in anger.
Her almond eyes went wide as she tried to struggle against his grip.
"Even if you don’t give this to Yun Wanqing, you should keep it for yourself!
It could resolve your False Core issue!
It could let you advance!"
Zhang Xian held her hand tighter.
He spoke over her panic, his voice low, clear, and carrying a terrifying seriousness.
"Li Fuxi.
Be my woman."
The words exploded in Li Fuxi’s mind like a thunderclap from a clear sky.
All her struggles, her shame, her anger, and her reason were blasted to dust in that instant.
Her cheeks ignited, flushing a deep, alluring crimson.
[Ding!
Current Favorability: 74.]
[Ding!
Gift of Primordial Creation Pill successful.
Triggered return: Primordial Creation Pill x100.]
[Primordial Creation Pill: Peak Earth-grade.
Heals shattered Golden Cores and dispersed Nascent Souls; reverses foundation collapse.
Activates and repairs meridians and spiritual roots.
A legendary treasure that defies fate to reshape the Dao Foundation.]
"You... what nonsense are you spouting?!" Li Fuxi stammered, her composure shattering.
I am your master!
This... this is unacceptable!"
Zhang Xian, seeing her flustered state, smiled deeply.
Like a magician, he produced a few books from his spatial storage.
The covers were garish and unmistakable: Help, My Yandere Master Fell for Me and The Legend of the Condor Heroes.
He waved them before her eyes.
"Master quite enjoys reading these, doesn’t she?
What’s the matter?" He leaned in to whisper, "Isn't the teacher-disciple dynamic even more exciting?"
"You... you..."
Li Fuxi stared at the mortifying titles.
A rush of blood surged to her head, making her dizzy.
She wished the floor would crack open and swallow her whole.
That wretched disciple!
How did he know?
And to bring them out now?
However, her indignant rebuke was choked off by a sudden, explosive surge of medicinal power erupting within her body.
"Mmph!" Li Fuxi grunted, her eyes flying wide open.
The pill transformed into tidal waves of warm energy.
Her damaged meridians were rapidly repaired, forced open, and widened.
Her shattered, dim Golden Core and dual spiritual roots began to glow like stars.
Slowly, they began to rotate and coalesce, following a profound, mystical trajectory.
The sheer volume of power, the exquisite precision of the repair—it was overwhelming.
This effect was terrifyingly potent, surpassing the Heaven-Seizing Heart-Mending Lotus Seed by magnitudes.
She could sense the repaired Golden Core possessed a spiritual essence purer and more powerful than her original one.
This is definitely not the Creation Immortal Pill.
A storm of shock raged in Li Fuxi’s heart.
She looked sharply at Zhang Xian, her eyes filled with astonishment, confusion, and an inexpressible surge of gratitude.
This heaven-defying medicine could have resolved his False Core issue.
It could have let him be reborn.
And he gave it to her without a second thought?
Zhang Xian seemed to see through her turmoil.
He gently patted the back of her hand, his voice soft yet firm.
"Master, rest assured.
I have more where that came from.
Just focus on your recovery.
Yinyin and I will come see you again tomorrow."
Li Fuxi looked at him, a thousand words stuck in her throat.
In the end, she could only manage a soft, trembling sound.
"Mmm."
She slowly closed her eyes, concentrating fully on guiding the vast medicinal power.
Unlike last time, the joy of restoring her cultivation was drowned out by another emotion—something more turbulent, and infinitely sweeter.
Zhang Xian slowly stood up.
He gave a meaningful look to the dumbfounded Lin Yinyin.
The two of them quietly tiptoed out of the room, leaving the master to her healing.

chapters.title: Chapter 133 He Must Have Eaten His Fill Before Coming Back
paragraphs: The moment they stepped into the privacy of the courtyard, Lin Yinyin could no longer contain herself. She squared her shoulders and deepened her voice, mimicking Zhang Xian’s earlier baritone.
"Li Fuxi, be my woman."
She dropped the act instantly, her face twisting into a playful grimace. "Brother, you’re so smooth. It’s honestly disgusting."
She looked him up and down, her lower lip jutting out in a pout. "Now that you have Yun Wanqing, and now you have Master too... are you just going to toss Yinyin to the back of your mind?"
Zhang Xian couldn't help but chuckle. She looked like a bristling kitten trying to be intimidating. He reached out, gently flicking the tip of her upturned nose.
"How could I? I could never forget our little Yinyin."

The intimate gesture made her flush a sudden crimson. She fidgeted, glancing left and right to ensure the coast was truly clear. Then, she leaned in, pressing her body close to his. Her voice dropped to a husky whisper filled with shy anticipation.
"Brother... your match isn't until the day after tomorrow. Master is meditating to recover right now... so..."
She trailed off, her face burning like a ripe apple. "How about we... tonight...?"

Zhang Xian looked at her bashful, inviting expression, and felt his resolve waver. Under any other circumstances, he would have agreed in a heartbeat. But right now, the burning heat in his dantian was a stark reminder that he had far more critical matters to attend to.
With great reluctance, he had to decline.

He lowered his head, planting a quick peck on her smooth forehead. "Another day, okay? Be good. Your brother needs to go into seclusion immediately. I have to see if I can resolve this False Core issue once and for all."
Without giving Lin Yinyin a chance to argue or seduce him further, he turned and bolted toward his meditation chamber, the very picture of a man fleeing temptation.
"Zhang Xian!!"
Lin Yinyin stared at his retreating back, stomping her foot in frustration. Her face was beet red, her fists clenched at her sides.
"Just brushing me off like that? He must have eaten his fill over at Yun Wanqing’s before coming back! Hmph!!"
She shook a tiny fist at the closed door, feeling a mix of embarrassment and annoyance, yet utterly helpless to stop him.
Inside the meditation chamber, heavy silence reigned.
Zhang Xian sat cross-legged, cradling the Primordial Creation Pill in his palm. The pill emitted a misty, shifting glow that reflected the wild anticipation in his eyes.
"For you, I painfully turned down invitations from two peerless beauties today," he murmured to the artifact.
Images of Yun Wanqing’s shy charm and Lin Yinyin’s pouting face flashed through his mind, but they were quickly incinerated by a fiercer desire. He had waited for this day for far too long.
He brought the pill to his lips and swallowed.
Boom!

A torrential force swept through his limbs and bones instantly. It didn't melt; it detonated. It felt as if a thunderstorm had been unleashed inside his veins. The vast medicinal power acted like a divine carving knife, using his origin as the core to frantically reshape, sculpt, and perfect his being.
His False Core trembled violently. Impurities were purged in clouds of black smoke; structural flaws were optimized. An unprecedented sense of wholeness and solidity rose from his dantian.

Simultaneously, the artificial Wood Spiritual Root—painstakingly built from countless rare herbs and treasures—began to transform. Under the scouring of the medicinal power, it shed its mortal limitations, evolving into a genuine, High-Grade Wood Spiritual Root.
The metamorphosis didn't stop there.
From the depths of his inner palace, four faint yet undeniably real sprouts emerged—Metal, Water, Fire, Earth!

Although they were currently of the lowest grade, their appearance meant he was no longer a single-element cultivator. He was now a genuine master of all five elements—a possessor of a Mixed Spiritual Root.

In the cultivation world, Mixed Spiritual Roots were often looked down upon as the mark of mediocre talent, as splitting one's focus usually resulted in weak affinity across the board. However, Zhang Xian now possessed a High-Grade Wood Root as his anchor. The addition of the other four elements didn't dilute his power; it completed it.
Moreover, even a low-grade natural root was infinitely superior to the artificial construct he had started with.
Zhang Xian looked inward, observing the flawless, perfectly round Golden Core spinning in his dantian. A faint, multi-colored spiritual light swirled around it in perfect harmony.
His eyes grew hot. He took a deep breath, attempting to draw upon the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
Whoosh.

Instantly, wisps of pure Five Elements energy rushed toward him as if summoned by a monarch. They flowed smoothly into his meridians, transformed and absorbed by the Golden Core without the slightest hitch.

An unprecedented feeling of comfort washed over him. It was as if he had been breathing through a straw his entire life, and suddenly, he could fill his lungs with pure oxygen. Every pore on his body seemed to cheer.
"This... this is what a real spiritual root feels like," he whispered, his voice trembling.
The sensation was stark. It was like a peasant who had eaten nothing but chaff and wild weeds his whole life suddenly tasting a royal banquet.
The 'False Core' affliction that had plagued him for years was finally, completely resolved.

From this moment on, he was no longer a counterfeit genius who relied on external items and schemes to compensate for a cracked foundation. He was a Golden Core Perfected One, a true powerhouse with a High-Grade Wood Root and a complete elemental cycle.
As the euphoria settled, a trace of regret surfaced.

Aside from Wood, his other four roots were merely low-grade. Furthermore, due to the drug resistance built up from consuming excessive Immortal Ascension Pills and Marrow Cleansing Pills in the past, he couldn't improve them with standard medicines for the time being.
But then, a confident curve touched the corner of Zhang Xian’s mouth.
He remembered his ace in the hole: the [Distinguished Disciple Halo (Limited)].

Although it was a one-time activation and was already locked onto his master, Li Fuxi, its effects were passive and permanent. The heaven-defying aspect of this halo was that it allowed him to share his master’s potential—including her spiritual root talents.
Li Fuxi currently possessed a Fourth-Grade Golden Core and top-tier Metal and Water Dual Spiritual Roots.
As long as she improved, he would improve.
He could already feel it—his new Metal and Water roots were slowly, rhythmically evolving, drafting off her talent.
He needed to quickly... satisfy his master. If he could help her break through to the Nascent Soul stage, he would benefit from the spillover immediately.
"I need to feed her well so I can drink the soup," Zhang Xian thought, overjoyed at the prospect.
With his greatest weakness erased, Zhang Xian’s mind was clear and serene. He began to organize his objectives.
First: Win the Demon Sweeping Assembly. This was his promise to Heavenly Puppet Peak, and the rewards were non-negotiable.

Second: Travel to Penglai Immortal Island. He needed to find Lele, who should be with Su Ling and that mysterious Supreme Elder. Given that the Elder had gifted him the Creation Immortal Pill, logic and courtesy dictated he pay a visit to express his gratitude.
Third: The [Demon Nest]. This was the final target of his revenge plan. This enmity was irreconcilable; the nest had to burn.

Fourth: Yang Poxiao. The man might be crippled, but Zhang Xian knew better than to underestimate a protagonist archetype. Yang Poxiao had the real version of the Halo and terrifying potential. Since they were sworn enemies, Zhang Xian could not afford to leave even a spark of life in that fire. He had to pull the weeds up by the roots.
Finally: The System Upgrade. Progress had reached 80%. He was eager to see what functions would unlock at 100%.
"Currently, Liu Qingxuan, Li Fuxi, and Yun Wanqing are all hovering in the 70s for Favorability," he mused. "After the tournament, I need to focus on pushing those numbers up."
For two consecutive days, Zhang Xian remained in the meditation chamber.

He consolidated his realm, familiarized himself with the surge of new power, and practiced the operation of his Five Elements spiritual roots until they flowed like water. He drilled his coordination with his puppets until it was instinctual.
Only when the great bell rang, signaling the start of the finals, did he push open the stone door.
In the courtyard, Li Fuxi and Lin Yinyin were waiting.

Li Fuxi’s complexion was rosy and healthy, a stark contrast to two days ago. However, her aura was deliberately restrained, making her appear somewhat weak and frail to the untrained eye. Lin Yinyin stood by her side, alert as a little bodyguard.
Zhang Xian quickly checked her status with the System.
[Li Fuxi: Daughter of Destiny (77 Points). Current Favorability: 79.]
Good. Her lost destiny had returned, and she was even stronger than before.

Li Fuxi looked up, catching his analytical gaze. She smiled softly. "I’m fine. My injuries have completely healed—in fact, I am stronger than I was before. That pill of yours... it truly is a divine object that seizes the creation of heaven."

Her voice lowered, carrying a note of strategic caution. "I am suppressing my aura. You displayed too much wealth and too many treasures the other day. Covetous eyes are already watching you. If I were to suddenly appear fully healed and powered up, it would only paint a larger target on your back."

chapters.title: Chapter 134 What Kind of Prowess Are You Going to Show
paragraphs: Zhang Xian felt a surge of warmth at Li Fuxi’s genuine concern. It was a stark contrast to the transactional nature of the cultivation world.

Lin Yinyin, who had been nursing a slight grudge over his abrupt departure earlier, suddenly paused. She sensed the shift in his presence—an unusually harmonious, complete aura that hadn't been there before. Her eyes lit up.
"Brother, your aura... it’s changed."

Zhang Xian beamed, radiating confidence. "The False Core issue is history. I am a genuine Golden Core cultivator now, fourth stage. Not only do I possess a High-Grade Wood Spirit Root, but I’ve awakened the other four elements as well."
"Only a High-Grade Wood root?" Lin Yinyin’s heart swelled with joy for him, but she couldn't resist a playful jab. She tilted her chin up. "I have a Heavenly Spirit Root, you know!"

Li Fuxi shook her head, admonishing her gently. "Yinyin, do not be complacent. Zhang Xian rose from a mortal body. Through sheer perseverance, he has reached this height. The hardships he endured are beyond your imagination. That tenacity is a treasure far rarer than talent."
Lin Yinyin sighed inwardly. Oh no, Master has completely fallen for him. Now she sees nothing but virtues in her sweetheart.
Zhang Xian laughed heartily. He stepped forward, taking Li Fuxi’s cool hand in his left and grasping Lin Yinyin’s hand with his right.
"Watch your husband dominate the arena today. I’ll show you what true power looks like."
Blushing crimson, Li Fuxi jerked her hand back as if she’d been burned, retreating a step. "I... I haven't agreed to that yet... I think it's better if we remain master and disciple..."
Her shy, flustered stammer made Zhang Xian’s heart flutter, but Lin Yinyin was less impressed. She eyed him suspiciously.

"What kind of prowess are you planning to show? I’m warning you, you already have Master and Sect Master Yun. Don’t go flirting with other girls. That Fairy Long Zhi is stunningly beautiful; you better not get any crooked ideas!"
Zhang Xian rubbed his temples in exasperation. "Yinyin, how can you view me with such suspicion? Am I that kind of person?"
"Yes!"

Ignoring their banter, Li Fuxi cut in, her expression serious. "Long Zhi is upright and pure. She possesses a clear and bright Sword Heart. When I lost to her years ago, it was simply because my skills were inferior. The other day, when she intervened to stop Yang Poxiao, it was an act of reason. Do not hold a grudge against her because of a wretch like Yang."
Zhang Xian nodded, his expression sobering. "Don’t worry, Master. I understand. Today’s battle is solely for the championship."
The trio arrived at the bustling training grounds. The noise of the crowd was deafening, but on the final match arena, silence reigned.
Long Zhi stood waiting.

Dressed in robes whiter than snow, her peerless beauty made her look like a celestial being exiled to the mortal dust. An aloof, untouchable chill emanated from her, an invisible barrier that kept the world at arm's length.
Zhang Xian stepped onto the platform and discreetly triggered the System.
[Long Zhi: Daughter of Destiny (93 Points). Current Favorability: 0.]
Her score was even higher than their last encounter. A Destiny Value of 93 was the highest he had ever seen.

Her aura was restrained to the extreme, seemingly fused with the heaven and earth around her. It faintly reminded him of Sect Master Xingji. She was truly standing on the threshold of the Nascent Soul realm.
The final match officially began.

Zhang Xian didn't waste a second. With a thought, four puppets of different attributes materialized instantly. Golden, blue, red, and yellow spiritual lights swirled around them. Combined with the verdant Wood energy radiating from his own body, the five elemental auras flowed and interwove, locking into an endlessly regenerative formation.
Long Zhi’s expression remained placid. She lightly raised a slender hand, and an ice-blue longsword slid from its sheath with a clear shing!
The sword’s hum was crisp and melodious, echoing with the faint roar of a dragon. A flash of purple lightning crackled in her eyes, and a crushing pressure descended upon the stage.
She didn't speak. She just struck.

There was no earth-shattering explosion, no wasted movement. There was only a single ribbon of purple sword radiance, condensed to the extreme, shearing through the air as it shot straight for Zhang Xian’s face.
Zhang Xian’s pupils contracted. Fast!
He retreated swiftly, his own sword transforming into a wall of emerald-green energy to guard his vitals. Simultaneously, the four puppets charged forward without hesitation.
This time, he intended to face her head-on—openly and honorably.
Exclamations erupted from the VIP platform.
"He’s gotten stronger again!"
"Fourth level Golden Core? He was only at the third level days ago. Strange... this doesn't feel like the unstable aura of a False Core technique."
"All five elements? He’s only revealing a Mixed Spirit Root now? But that Wood aura is too potent. Is that a mutant variation? Or just a mongrel anomaly?"
"Who knows? This kid has too many secrets. Could he really be the reincarnation of some ancient immortal?"

Long Zhi moved with the fluid grace of a startled swan, weaving amidst the assault of the four puppets. Her swordsmanship was simple, efficient, and devoid of any superfluous flourish, yet every strike contained terrifying, explosive thunder power. Facing one against five, she didn't yield an inch.

On the high seats, two elders from the Spirit Ruins Sword Sect watched with gratification. Long Zhi truly lived up to her title as the sect's most outstanding genius in a millennium. Her Sword Heart was flawless, undisturbed by the chaos of the world. Even Yang Poxiao’s betrayal hadn’t left a scratch on her mental state.
But Zhang Xian’s performance was equally shocking.
"How has his swordsmanship improved so drastically?" a Yunmiao Sect elder exclaimed, leaning forward.

The Yunmiao Sword Scripture executed by Zhang Xian possessed an unprecedented solidity. Within the agile, graceful movements lay a heavy, rolling momentum. His Wood-type Sword Intent was endless, carrying the faint, unmistakable bearing of a grandmaster.
Even more astonishing was the Fire Puppet. Its broadsword swings were wide and tyrannical, blazing flames soaring to the sky, bearing an uncanny resemblance to Yang Poxiao’s heavy sword style.
The five figures cooperated seamlessly. The five elements flowed and interchanged, generating and restraining each other, holding their ground against Long Zhi’s overwhelming sharpness.
"Brother is amazing!" Lin Yinyin watched, mesmerized, her small hands clenched in excitement.

Li Fuxi’s eyes shone with admiration. She whispered, "His foundation is solid now, reborn and transformed. His control over spiritual power and understanding of the sword have naturally risen with his potential."
Seeing the familiar, unique essence of her own personal style within Zhang Xian’s movements, a trace of sweetness welled up in her heart. It seems I, as a master, haven't taught him too badly.
She had no idea that Zhang Xian was mentally thanking the [Master Teacher Halo].

In just a few days, he had gained deeper insights into the Yunmiao Sword Scripture—Li Fuxi's specialty—simply by being near her. Even rarer, the Water and Metal Spirit Roots within him were passively evolving toward mid-grade thanks to the halo’s mirroring effect.
As he swung his sword, his gaze involuntarily drifted toward the stands, locking onto Li Fuxi’s gentle, focused eyes. Li Fuxi’s heart skipped a beat, and she hurriedly looked away.
"Master, look! Brother is sneaking glances at you!" Lin Yinyin teased, nudging her.
"He... he’s getting distracted during a match. He deserves a scolding!" Li Fuxi’s voice trembled. She tried to sound stern, but the slight upward curve of her lips betrayed her completely.
On the arena, the battle intensified.

Zhang Xian grew more comfortable with every exchange. With a thought, Gold and Wood spiritual power merged within his meridians. A light, agile wind naturally generated beneath his feet, making his movements elusive and boosting his speed significantly.
He felt a secret thrill. Now that I possess all five elements, I can fuse them to simulate variant roots like Wind or Lightning. I just need time to explore it.
But as the fight raged on, a faint sense of peculiarity lingered in Zhang Xian’s mind.

He couldn't shake the feeling that Long Zhi wasn't going all out. Her sword pressure was sharp enough to suppress him, certainly, yet she always seemed to leave a fraction of space, as if she were deliberately holding something back.

sentences.text: Zhang Xian felt a surge of warmth at Li Fuxi’s genuine concern.
It was a stark contrast to the transactional nature of the cultivation world.
Lin Yinyin, who had been nursing a slight grudge over his abrupt departure earlier, suddenly paused.
She sensed the shift in his presence—an unusually harmonious, complete aura that hadn't been there before.
Her eyes lit up.
"Brother, your aura... it’s changed."
Zhang Xian beamed, radiating confidence.
"The False Core issue is history.
I am a genuine Golden Core cultivator now, fourth stage.
Not only do I possess a High-Grade Wood Spirit Root, but I’ve awakened the other four elements as well."
"Only a High-Grade Wood root?" Lin Yinyin’s heart swelled with joy for him, but she couldn't resist a playful jab.
She tilted her chin up.
"I have a Heavenly Spirit Root, you know!"
Li Fuxi shook her head, admonishing her gently.
"Yinyin, do not be complacent.
Zhang Xian rose from a mortal body.
Through sheer perseverance, he has reached this height.
The hardships he endured are beyond your imagination.
That tenacity is a treasure far rarer than talent."
Lin Yinyin sighed inwardly.
Oh no, Master has completely fallen for him.
Now she sees nothing but virtues in her sweetheart.
Zhang Xian laughed heartily.
He stepped forward, taking Li Fuxi’s cool hand in his left and grasping Lin Yinyin’s hand with his right.
"Watch your husband dominate the arena today.
I’ll show you what true power looks like."
Blushing crimson, Li Fuxi jerked her hand back as if she’d been burned, retreating a step.
I haven't agreed to that yet...
I think it's better if we remain master and disciple..."
Her shy, flustered stammer made Zhang Xian’s heart flutter, but Lin Yinyin was less impressed.
She eyed him suspiciously.
"What kind of prowess are you planning to show?
I’m warning you, you already have Master and Sect Master Yun.
Don’t go flirting with other girls.
That Fairy Long Zhi is stunningly beautiful; you better not get any crooked ideas!"
Zhang Xian rubbed his temples in exasperation.
"Yinyin, how can you view me with such suspicion?
Am I that kind of person?"
"Yes!"
Ignoring their banter, Li Fuxi cut in, her expression serious.
"Long Zhi is upright and pure.
She possesses a clear and bright Sword Heart.
When I lost to her years ago, it was simply because my skills were inferior.
The other day, when she intervened to stop Yang Poxiao, it was an act of reason.
Do not hold a grudge against her because of a wretch like Yang."
Zhang Xian nodded, his expression sobering.
"Don’t worry, Master.
I understand.
Today’s battle is solely for the championship."
The trio arrived at the bustling training grounds.
The noise of the crowd was deafening, but on the final match arena, silence reigned.
Long Zhi stood waiting.
Dressed in robes whiter than snow, her peerless beauty made her look like a celestial being exiled to the mortal dust.
An aloof, untouchable chill emanated from her, an invisible barrier that kept the world at arm's length.
Zhang Xian stepped onto the platform and discreetly triggered the System.
[Long Zhi: Daughter of Destiny (93 Points).
Current Favorability: 0.]
Her score was even higher than their last encounter.
A Destiny Value of 93 was the highest he had ever seen.
Her aura was restrained to the extreme, seemingly fused with the heaven and earth around her.
It faintly reminded him of Sect Master Xingji.
She was truly standing on the threshold of the Nascent Soul realm.
The final match officially began.
Zhang Xian didn't waste a second.
With a thought, four puppets of different attributes materialized instantly.
Golden, blue, red, and yellow spiritual lights swirled around them.
Combined with the verdant Wood energy radiating from his own body, the five elemental auras flowed and interwove, locking into an endlessly regenerative formation.
Long Zhi’s expression remained placid.
She lightly raised a slender hand, and an ice-blue longsword slid from its sheath with a clear shing!
The sword’s hum was crisp and melodious, echoing with the faint roar of a dragon.
A flash of purple lightning crackled in her eyes, and a crushing pressure descended upon the stage.
She didn't speak.
She just struck.
There was no earth-shattering explosion, no wasted movement.
There was only a single ribbon of purple sword radiance, condensed to the extreme, shearing through the air as it shot straight for Zhang Xian’s face.
Zhang Xian’s pupils contracted.
Fast!
He retreated swiftly, his own sword transforming into a wall of emerald-green energy to guard his vitals.
Simultaneously, the four puppets charged forward without hesitation.
This time, he intended to face her head-on—openly and honorably.
Exclamations erupted from the VIP platform.
"He’s gotten stronger again!"
"Fourth level Golden Core?
He was only at the third level days ago.
Strange... this doesn't feel like the unstable aura of a False Core technique."
"All five elements?
He’s only revealing a Mixed Spirit Root now?
But that Wood aura is too potent.
Is that a mutant variation?
Or just a mongrel anomaly?"
"Who knows?
This kid has too many secrets.
Could he really be the reincarnation of some ancient immortal?"
Long Zhi moved with the fluid grace of a startled swan, weaving amidst the assault of the four puppets.
Her swordsmanship was simple, efficient, and devoid of any superfluous flourish, yet every strike contained terrifying, explosive thunder power.
Facing one against five, she didn't yield an inch.
On the high seats, two elders from the Spirit Ruins Sword Sect watched with gratification.
Long Zhi truly lived up to her title as the sect's most outstanding genius in a millennium.
Her Sword Heart was flawless, undisturbed by the chaos of the world.
Even Yang Poxiao’s betrayal hadn’t left a scratch on her mental state.
But Zhang Xian’s performance was equally shocking.
"How has his swordsmanship improved so drastically?" a Yunmiao Sect elder exclaimed, leaning forward.
The Yunmiao Sword Scripture executed by Zhang Xian possessed an unprecedented solidity.
Within the agile, graceful movements lay a heavy, rolling momentum.
His Wood-type Sword Intent was endless, carrying the faint, unmistakable bearing of a grandmaster.
Even more astonishing was the Fire Puppet.
Its broadsword swings were wide and tyrannical, blazing flames soaring to the sky, bearing an uncanny resemblance to Yang Poxiao’s heavy sword style.
The five figures cooperated seamlessly.
The five elements flowed and interchanged, generating and restraining each other, holding their ground against Long Zhi’s overwhelming sharpness.
"Brother is amazing!" Lin Yinyin watched, mesmerized, her small hands clenched in excitement.
Li Fuxi’s eyes shone with admiration.
She whispered, "His foundation is solid now, reborn and transformed.
His control over spiritual power and understanding of the sword have naturally risen with his potential."
Seeing the familiar, unique essence of her own personal style within Zhang Xian’s movements, a trace of sweetness welled up in her heart.
It seems I, as a master, haven't taught him too badly.
She had no idea that Zhang Xian was mentally thanking the [Master Teacher Halo].
In just a few days, he had gained deeper insights into the Yunmiao Sword Scripture—Li Fuxi's specialty—simply by being near her.
Even rarer, the Water and Metal Spirit Roots within him were passively evolving toward mid-grade thanks to the halo’s mirroring effect.
As he swung his sword, his gaze involuntarily drifted toward the stands, locking onto Li Fuxi’s gentle, focused eyes.
Li Fuxi’s heart skipped a beat, and she hurriedly looked away.
"Master, look!
Brother is sneaking glances at you!" Lin Yinyin teased, nudging her.
"He... he’s getting distracted during a match.
He deserves a scolding!" Li Fuxi’s voice trembled.
She tried to sound stern, but the slight upward curve of her lips betrayed her completely.
On the arena, the battle intensified.
Zhang Xian grew more comfortable with every exchange.
With a thought, Gold and Wood spiritual power merged within his meridians.
A light, agile wind naturally generated beneath his feet, making his movements elusive and boosting his speed significantly.
He felt a secret thrill.
Now that I possess all five elements, I can fuse them to simulate variant roots like Wind or Lightning.
I just need time to explore it.
But as the fight raged on, a faint sense of peculiarity lingered in Zhang Xian’s mind.
He couldn't shake the feeling that Long Zhi wasn't going all out.
Her sword pressure was sharp enough to suppress him, certainly, yet she always seemed to leave a fraction of space, as if she were deliberately holding something back.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 Turned into a Love-Struck Fool
paragraphs: High upon the observation platform, Emperor Xia Xuanyin frowned, his gaze fixed on the arena below. He leaned slightly toward the Spirit Ruins Sword Sect elder beside him.
"Fellow Daoist Long Zhi appears to be suppressing her realm, does she not?"

The elder bowed low. "Your Majesty has keen eyes. She has already reached the half-step Nascent Soul stage. Her aura is flawless, a drawn bowstring held at maximum tension. If she were to exert her full power now, it would likely trigger the Heavenly Tribulation. She is not yet fully prepared for the lightning, so she keeps her strength leashed just below the critical limit."
Xia Xuanyin’s eyes widened. "She can already sense the Tribulation? Two hundred years of cultivation... Such talent is truly terrifying."

As he spoke, a tremor ran through the air. Xia Xuanyin’s expression froze, and he snapped his head toward the southeastern sky. A kinetic force was piercing the Southern Capital’s defensive Grand Formation, moving with the speed of a falling star.
"Your Majesty?" the elder asked, alarmed by the Emperor’s sudden tension.
"The Zhou Heaven Protective Grand Formation has been breached," Xia Xuanyin stated, his voice dropping an octave. "An intruder is incoming. At least a Peak Golden Core cultivator."
He barked an order to General Han Yichen, who stood guard nearby like a statue of war. "General Han! Intercept and investigate immediately. Exercise utmost caution!"
"Your servant obeys!"
Han Yichen’s eyes flashed with lethal intent. Blood-red baleful energy erupted around him, transforming him into a crimson comet that tore through the sky to meet the threat.
The disturbance was loud enough that even the spectators began to crane their necks in confusion.
Meanwhile, on the dueling platform, the battle between Zhang Xian and Long Zhi raged on, oblivious to the sky above.
"Hey, have you noticed? Zhang Xian isn't using pills, Earth-grade talismans, or detonating spirit treasures this time!"
"Yeah! It’s a completely different style from his usual 'Pay-to-Win' atrocities."
"Could it be he's going easy on her because Immortal Long Zhi is a beauty?"
"Likely! I heard this guy is a massive lecher. There's even a faction within the Yunmiao Sect dedicated to protesting his crimes, though they haven't had much luck."
"Holy shit. He’s already marrying the Pavilion Master and he’s still not satisfied? He wants to lay hands on Immortal Long Zhi too? What a beast!"
The murmurs from the crowd drifted over to the Yunmiao Sect delegation. Lin Yinyin seized the opportunity to fan the flames.
"Master, look! Even the audience can tell Brother is holding back. He must have taken a fancy to Immortal Long Zhi."

Li Fuxi didn't take the bait. She watched the fight with soft, admiring eyes. "He isn't holding back. He is using this battle to test the limits of his new power. Those artifacts are merely crutches. Right now, he is displaying the steel that belongs to him alone."
Lin Yinyin stared at her master, dumbfounded.
It’s over. My formerly aloof and proud master is gone. She’s completely fallen in love. She’s turned into a love-struck fool who sees everything Brother does through rose-tinted glasses.
Just then, an earth-shattering boom echoed from the clouds.

Accompanied by a suppressed groan of pain, a crimson figure plummeted from the sky like a broken meteor. It crashed heavily onto the jade pavement at the edge of the arena, blasting open a deep crater and sending debris flying.
As the dust settled, a collective gasp swept through the stadium. Lying in the wreckage was General Han Yichen. His heavy armor was rent open, his chest heaving as he coughed up mouthfuls of blood.
Chaos erupted. Screams and shouts rose from all sides.
Xia Xuanyin stood up abruptly, his imperial aura flaring.

High in the sky, a figure shrouded entirely in a loose black robe hovered like a wraith. A wide hood concealed their face, revealing only a chin carved from cold, hard lines. In their hand, they casually twirled a broken spear tip—Han Yichen’s weapon.
An overwhelming Nascent Soul-level pressure descended like a physical weight, suffocating the entire martial arena. Even the sunlight seemed to dim under the oppressor’s shadow.

Xia Xuanyin vanished from his seat, reappearing in the air opposite the intruder. Zhiyin, Wang Ya, Yun He, and other powerful cultivators flashed to his side, their expressions grave as they formed a defensive line.
Suppressing his fury, Xia Xuanyin’s voice resounded through the heavens. "Which Fellow Daoist visits us? For what purpose do you forcibly intrude upon my Southern Region and injure my general?"
The black-robed figure let out a low, grating laugh that sounded like sandpaper rubbing against bone.
"Why such anger, Emperor Xia? This humble one is also from the Southern Region. Hearing that a lively Demon Sweeping Assembly is being held here, I simply came to join the festivities."
"From the Southern Region?" Xia Xuanyin’s pupils contracted. When did such an unfamiliar Nascent Soul expert appear in his territory?
On the dueling platform, Zhang Xian and Long Zhi had ceased fighting.

When the intruder spoke, Zhang Xian’s heart gave a violent jolt. That sandpaper voice—it was identical to the shadowy figure from the minor world, the one under the Withered Glory Samsara Restriction.
Is he the mastermind behind the Demon Nest?
Zhang Xian looked up at the mysterious figure. Xia Xuanyin and the others were confronting him, but something felt wrong.
Wait.
Zhang Xian’s blood ran cold. The dueling platform was isolated by a sound-proofing formation. He shouldn't have been able to hear that voice so clearly.
The formation has been breached.
Out of the corner of his eye, he spotted a stream of white energy at the platform's edge, silently corroding the barrier like acid.
Is the target the arena? Is it me, or Long Zhi?

Just as the alarm bells rang in his mind, a blurred afterimage shot out from a dark corner of the spectator stands. It bypassed the sky battle entirely, heading straight for Zhang Xian with lethal intent.
The ambush was instantaneous. Even with Zhang Xian’s heightened reflexes, he only had time to trigger his passive defenses.
Boom! Boom! Boom!

A series of heart-stopping explosions rang out. Several layers of protective spiritual light flared to life around Zhang Xian, only to be shattered instantly by the black afterimage. The attacker’s strength far surpassed the Golden Core stage.
Layer after layer of defense crumbled, but they bought him a fraction of a second.

As the final shield broke, strands of sinister black energy seeped through the cracks, winding toward Zhang Xian’s body like vipers. The aura carried a powerful corrosive and mental interference force. Before it even touched his skin, Zhang Xian felt a wave of dizziness and nausea rush to his head.
Crack!

A crisp shattering sound came from within his robes. The Orange Heart Pendant—Yun Wanqing’s gift—exploded. Unable to withstand the erosion and mental assault, it sacrificed itself, the warm fragments pricking Zhang Xian's chest.
That brief pain cleared his mind.
Zhang Xian activated the Teleportation Wind Talisman he had been clutching in his palm since the intruder appeared.
Whoosh.
He vanished.

The black shadow, clearly a Nascent Soul assassin, hadn’t expected a mere Golden Core junior to possess so many layers of high-grade defense. He glanced at the corner of the platform where Zhang Xian reappeared, instantly surrounded by several fresh Earth-grade spirit shields.
Defenses maxed out.
The assassin didn't waste time. His figure twisted eerily in mid-air, abandoning the hard target. He turned his killing intent toward Long Zhi.
Only now did the crowd react to the lightning-fast assassination attempt. Screams erupted like a tidal wave.
"Brother!" Lin Yinyin shrieked.
Li Fuxi reacted the fastest. Icy energy exploded from her body as she transformed into a streak of white light, charging straight for the dueling platform to save her disciple.
However, just as she was about to cross the boundary...
Hum!
An enormous, mountainously thick, earthen-yellow light shield materialized out of nowhere. It formed a perfect semi-circle, like a giant inverted bowl, instantly sealing the entire dueling platform.
Zhang Xian, Long Zhi, and the black-robed assassin were trapped inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 136 Black and White
paragraphs: Li Fuxi, eyes burning with fury, unleashed a slash of Ice Glaze Sword Qi with everything she had.
Boom!
The strike slammed into the translucent dome, but instead of shattering, the barrier merely rippled like a disturbed pond, emitting a dull, thunderous thud.
"What?!"

Li Fuxi staggered back from the recoil, her stunning face etched with disbelief. The defensive power of this light shield defied logic. Her gaze shifted to the source—a hulking, shadowy figure standing beside the assassin inside the dome.

This giant, shrouded in the same black robes as its master, was clearly a puppet. Li Fuxi had seen the Nascent Soul assassin summon it from a storage device just seconds ago. It stood motionless, acting as the anchor for the massive, semi-circular barrier that now sealed the arena off from the world.
Li Fuxi didn't let the shock paralyze her. She steadied her breath, channeling her spiritual power for an even stronger strike. Boom! The shield groaned but held firm.
By now, the other cultivators around the stage had shaken off their stupor. Spells and weapon strikes rained down in a chaotic, desperate storm, bombarding the barrier to no avail.
But inside the dome, the killing intent had already boiled over.
Having deployed the puppet to block outside interference, the Nascent Soul assassin didn't pause. He pounced toward Long Zhi like a panther.
Long Zhi, though startled, didn't flinch. A cold light erupted in her frosty eyes. Faced with a Nascent Soul-level ambush, she didn't retreat. Instead, she advanced.

Her spirit sword emitted a clear, dragon-like cry. Wrapped in leaping arcs of purple lightning, she thrust straight for the assassin’s heart. The strike was sharp, relentless, and carried the full weight of her resolve.
Yet, the shadow neither dodged nor evaded.
His right hand, shrouded in darkness, shot out like a viper. His fingers hooked into claws, bypassing the lightning to grab the tip of Long Zhi’s spirit sword with terrifying precision.
Hiss!
A viscous white energy surged from the assassin's palm, coiling around the blade of the Ice Glaze Sword like a parasitic worm.

Long Zhi’s expression changed drastically. She could feel the spiritual nature of her life-bound treasure screaming in agony as the bizarre white energy violently eroded its connection to her soul. The sword hummed in pain, its radiance dimming rapidly.
In the split second her mind wavered from the backlash, the assassin’s other hand moved.
He formed his palm into a spear-hand, fingertips wreathed in condensed, obsidian light. Before Long Zhi could recover, he stabbed straight toward her unguarded left shoulder.
Thud!
A sickening sound of flesh tearing echoed in the silence.

Long Zhi grunted, staggering back. A bloody hole had been punched through her shoulder, instantly staining her snow-white robes crimson. The black light hadn't just pierced her physical defense; a sinister, malicious chill was now flooding her meridians, shutting down her circulation.
"Long Zhi!
Outside the barrier, the elders of the Spirit Ruins Sword Sect roared in fury, their eyes bloodshot as they pounded uselessly against the shield.
High above, Xia Xuanyin, Zhiyin, Wang Ya, and the others finally snapped to realization.
They had been played.

The black-robed figure in the sky was nothing but a decoy. His flashy entrance and challenge were a diversion to draw their eyes upward. The true targets were the two geniuses on the platform—Zhang Xian and Long Zhi.
"Bastards!"
Xia Xuanyin’s rage erupted, his imperial majesty exploding like a sun. A golden talisman seal manifested in his hand, expanding into a mountain-sized rune that crashed down toward the barrier below.

The decoy in the sky laughed. He flicked a finger, releasing a wisp of white mist that intercepted the Emperor's attack. The mist churned, dissolving the golden seal’s power into nothingness as if it were mere smoke.
Xia Xuanyin’s heart jolted. What is that white energy? It eats spiritual power?
Before the Emperor could strike again, the decoy spread his arms wide.
"Myriad Spirits Return to Ruins."
With a low shout, the void behind him cracked open. Ten thousand illusory sword shadows materialized, fanning out like the wings of a death god. Each blade exuded a chilling, necrotic aura.

"What? The Myriad Spirits Sword Array?" A white-haired elder of the Spirit Ruins Sword Sect exclaimed in horror. This was their sect's ultimate, signature art—but the black aura clinging to the blades twisted it into something alien and terrifying.
The decoy swung his arms down.

The storm of ten thousand swords didn't aim for the Nascent Soul experts. Instead, it descended like a torrential downpour toward the tens of thousands of terrified low-level cultivators in the spectator stands.
"Despicable!"
Xia Xuanyin’s face went pale. He could tank the attack easily, but he couldn't let his subjects be slaughtered.
"Save them!"

The Emperor roared, hurling his Jade Seal into the sky. It transformed into a massive golden dragon that threw its body in the path of the sword rain. Zhiyin split into multiple clones, and Wang Ya erected a massive sword screen. The top experts of the Southern Region were forced to abandon the arena to intercept the sky-blotting massacre.
At that moment, Perfected Being Shouheng, who had kept his eyes on the arena, screamed out a warning.
"No! That’s not a simple defensive formation! It’s a teleportation array! The four corners of the shield are the anchors! They’re initiating a spatial jump! Stop them!
But his warning came a heartbeat too late.
The instant his words fell, the four corners of the massive earth-yellow dome erupted with blinding white light. Four beams shot upward, converging at the apex to form a complex, profound rune.
Space inside the dome began to twist and buckle like water disturbed by a stone.
Li Fuxi, desperate to break through, slammed her sword against the barrier one last time. Through the distorted, warping light, her eyes locked with Zhang Xian’s.
Inside the trap, Zhang Xian looked back at her. His lips moved soundlessly, forming two distinct words:
"Wait for me."
His gaze was calm, deep as an abyss, and it seared itself into her memory.
Hum!
A low, resonant thrum of spatial energy vibrated through the stadium. A flash of blinding white light swallowed the platform.
When the light faded, the massive dome popped like a soap bubble.
The arena was empty.
Zhang Xian, Long Zhi, the assassin, and the puppet—all gone. Only a few stark drops of Long Zhi’s blood remained on the jade floor, along with the fading ripples of teleportation magic.
High in the sky, the decoy saw his mission was complete. He let out a series of triumphant, rasping laughs.
"You hypocrites have slain many of my sect's disciples these past years. Today’s act is merely a reciprocal gesture. A small lesson in loss. Farewell!"

With a sinister chuckle, his body detonated into a cloud of blood mist. The mist coalesced into a streak of crimson light that shot toward the horizon with impossible speed, vanishing before anyone could give chase.
Xia Xuanyin landed on the empty platform, his face grim.
He extended a hand, plucking a wisp of residual energy from the air. The aura manifested as a pure, milky white thread.

"This white energy..." His voice was low, trembling with disbelief. "It is incredibly pure. Undoubtedly the essence of life itself. Yet they have twisted it, weaponized it into a poison capable of corroding formations, spells, and even the foundation of spirit treasures."
He plucked another thread, this one black as ink.
"And this black energy is even more bizarre. It is filled with pure negativity. It is unlike any unorthodox cultivation method I have ever encountered."
He crushed the energies between his fingers, his eyes cold. "Life and Death. What kind of monsters are we dealing with?"

Boom!
The strike slammed into the translucent dome, but instead of shattering, the barrier merely rippled like a disturbed pond, emitting a dull, thunderous thud.
"What?!"
Li Fuxi staggered back from the recoil, her stunning face etched with disbelief.
The defensive power of this light shield defied logic.
Her gaze shifted to the source—a hulking, shadowy figure standing beside the assassin inside the dome.
This giant, shrouded in the same black robes as its master, was clearly a puppet.
Li Fuxi had seen the Nascent Soul assassin summon it from a storage device just seconds ago.
It stood motionless, acting as the anchor for the massive, semi-circular barrier that now sealed the arena off from the world.
Li Fuxi didn't let the shock paralyze her.
She steadied her breath, channeling her spiritual power for an even stronger strike.
Boom!
The shield groaned but held firm.
By now, the other cultivators around the stage had shaken off their stupor.
Spells and weapon strikes rained down in a chaotic, desperate storm, bombarding the barrier to no avail.
But inside the dome, the killing intent had already boiled over.
Having deployed the puppet to block outside interference, the Nascent Soul assassin didn't pause.
He pounced toward Long Zhi like a panther.
Long Zhi, though startled, didn't flinch.
A cold light erupted in her frosty eyes.
Faced with a Nascent Soul-level ambush, she didn't retreat.
Instead, she advanced.
Her spirit sword emitted a clear, dragon-like cry.
Wrapped in leaping arcs of purple lightning, she thrust straight for the assassin’s heart.
The strike was sharp, relentless, and carried the full weight of her resolve.
Yet, the shadow neither dodged nor evaded.
His right hand, shrouded in darkness, shot out like a viper.
His fingers hooked into claws, bypassing the lightning to grab the tip of Long Zhi’s spirit sword with terrifying precision.
Hiss!
A viscous white energy surged from the assassin's palm, coiling around the blade of the Ice Glaze Sword like a parasitic worm.
Long Zhi’s expression changed drastically.
She could feel the spiritual nature of her life-bound treasure screaming in agony as the bizarre white energy violently eroded its connection to her soul.
The sword hummed in pain, its radiance dimming rapidly.
In the split second her mind wavered from the backlash, the assassin’s other hand moved.
He formed his palm into a spear-hand, fingertips wreathed in condensed, obsidian light.
Before Long Zhi could recover, he stabbed straight toward her unguarded left shoulder.
Thud!
A sickening sound of flesh tearing echoed in the silence.
Long Zhi grunted, staggering back.
A bloody hole had been punched through her shoulder, instantly staining her snow-white robes crimson.
The black light hadn't just pierced her physical defense; a sinister, malicious chill was now flooding her meridians, shutting down her circulation.
"Long Zhi!

They had been played.
The black-robed figure in the sky was nothing but a decoy.
His flashy entrance and challenge were a diversion to draw their eyes upward.
The true targets were the two geniuses on the platform—Zhang Xian and Long Zhi.

Xia Xuanyin’s rage erupted, his imperial majesty exploding like a sun.
A golden talisman seal manifested in his hand, expanding into a mountain-sized rune that crashed down toward the barrier below.

What is that white energy?
It eats spiritual power?
Before the Emperor could strike again, the decoy spread his arms wide.
"Myriad Spirits Return to Ruins."
With a low shout, the void behind him cracked open.
Ten thousand illusory sword shadows materialized, fanning out like the wings of a death god.
Each blade exuded a chilling, necrotic aura.
"What?

The decoy swung his arms down.
The storm of ten thousand swords didn't aim for the Nascent Soul experts.

The four corners of the shield are the anchors!
They’re initiating a spatial jump!
Stop them!

Four beams shot upward, converging at the apex to form a complex, profound rune.

chapters.title: Chapter 137 Just Superficial Acting
paragraphs: "That towering puppet," Zhiyin began, her brow furrowed as she scanned the residual spiritual signatures. "The core fluctuations match the Zhiyin II model I lost in the Demon Nest years ago. They have a master puppeteer—someone capable of gutting my designs and refitting them into those monstrosities."

Xia Xuanyin surveyed the ruined arena, his expression grim. "Their strength exceeds every projection. The black-robed assailant who engaged us fought with a cultivation no lower than my own. He is likely at the third level of the Nascent Soul stage."

"And the assassin who targeted the children?" The Emperor’s voice grew heavy. "Another Nascent Soul. Add in a peak Golden Core puppet, and this shadow organization already wields more power than the top-tier sects of the Southern Region combined."
Realist Wang Ya turned his attention to Li Fuxi. She stood in silence, her aura deep and strangely tranquil. There was no trace of the brittle fragility she had exhibited just days ago.
"Your injuries..." he ventured, his voice trailing off in disbelief.
"They are no longer a concern," Li Fuxi replied. Her voice was as calm as a still pond, devoid of the jagged pain that had defined her since the incident.

Wang Ya’s heart hammered against his ribs. No longer a concern? He had seen her foundation crumble; the "Jade Shattering" sacrifice of her Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra should have left her a permanent cripple. Yet here she was, her aura more refined and harmonious than it had been at her peak.
How did she do it? he wondered. Or rather... what did Zhang Xian do to her?
Li Fuxi ignored his shock, her eyes tracking the faint, ochre energy clinging to the edges of the crater. "That barrier," she said, glancing at Wang Ya. "Does it not strike you as familiar?"

Wang Ya narrowed his eyes. "The Dark Yellow Mountain-Suppressing Monolith. It’s a lost art—only a grandmaster of the Earth Dao could manifest such weight. That lineage hasn't been seen in the south for centuries. To see it used by a mere puppet..."
Before he could finish, Lin Yinyin sprinted toward them, her eyes red-rimmed and glistening. "Master! Big Brother was taken! They snatched him right out of the arena!"
"Peace, Yinyin," Li Fuxi said, her hand resting gently on her disciple's shoulder. "Zhang Xian was not captured. Not exactly."
Lin Yinyin blinked, her panic faltering against her master’s eerie certainty. "But... but they’re monsters! Two Nascent Soul elders!"

"He carries a teleportation Ephemeral Artifact," Li Fuxi analyzed. "When that shadow attacked Long Zhi, Zhang Xian had a window to flee. He chose to stay. Whatever is happening, he is there because he intends to be."
Yinyin’s face scrunched into a mask of worry. "I just hope he isn't being a stubborn idiot again..."
In a desolate, fog-choked valley leagues away, the air rippled like a disturbed pond. Three figures lurched into reality.

Long Zhi staggered, her hand clamped over her left shoulder. Blood bloomed across her snow-white robes like a grisly flower. In her other hand, her spirit sword—a weapon that had tasted the blood of a thousand foes—lay dim and cracked.
Wisps of white energy clung to the steel like starving maggots, eating away at the blade's spiritual essence. A flicker of genuine heartache crossed her cold features; the weapon was ruined.
Beside her, Zhang Xian was the picture of a terrified youth. His knees knocked together, and his voice went up a frantic octave. "W-who are you? What do you want with us?"
The hooded figure turned slowly. "A rhetorical question," the shadow replied, his voice a hollow rasp. "Do you not already call us 'Demons'?"
"You went through all this trouble just to kidnap us?" Zhang Xian’s eyes darted frantically. "Why?"
"To kill you," the shadow said flatly.

As the words left his lips, the massive Golden Core puppet stepped forward. It slammed its heavy palms into the dirt. Vrrroooom! An ochre dome of light erupted from the earth, sealing the valley in a tomb of geomantic energy.
"Wait! Don't kill me!" Zhang Xian shrieked, his hands held up in surrender. "I’ll flip! I’ll join you! I’ve got treasures, talismans—I’m a walking gold mine! Think of the return on investment!"
The shadow paused, looking Zhang Xian up and down as if weighing his soul. "Unnecessary."
"Wait, really?" Zhang Xian’s face fell. "Then... at least let me die with some closure. Who sent you? Why the tournament?"

"No." The shadow drew a blade forged from pure darkness, trailing wisps of a soul-corrupting mist. The tip leveled at Zhang Xian’s throat. "You’re still fishing for intel? You are remarkably calm for someone waiting for reinforcements that will never come."
Zhang Xian froze. This wasn't how the script was supposed to go. Where was the arrogant monologue? Where was the villainous gloating?
"You know me?" Zhang Xian’s voice lost its tremor. "Is this personal?"

"It’s professional," the shadow replied. "Our target is the finalists. That is all. Though... if you tell me where you get your endless supply of artifacts and those miraculous pills, I might grant you a quick death."

"Fine! I’ll talk!" Zhang Xian blurted. "I found an Ancient Immortal’s grotto. It’s filled to the brim. If you kill me, my storage space self-destructs and all those treasures get tossed into a dimensional rift. You’ll be burning a fortune for nothing!
The shadow fell silent. For a heartbeat, it seemed Zhang Xian’s "Whale" status might actually save him. Then, the assassin raised a hand and tapped the air.
"Heaven and Earth Prison: Seal."
The world went silent. The air turned to lead, and the flow of spiritual essence ground to a halt. Every inch of space was locked behind an invisible shackle.
"I watched your matches, boy," the shadow said coldly. "You’re full of tricks. But now the space is dead. Your teleportation trinkets are useless. You aren't going anywhere."
Zhang Xian’s pupils shrank. "Impossible!"
"Interesting," the shadow mused. "Even now, your breathing is steady. I look forward to seeing what you're actually hiding."

"He’s right," Long Zhi’s cold voice cut through the air. She stood tall, ignoring her wound. "Your heart rate is normal, and your spiritual power is circulating perfectly. You’re a terrible actor, Zhang Xian."
Zhang Xian rubbed the back of his neck, a sheepish grin replacing his mask of terror. "Ah... so it was just superficial acting? I'll have to work on that. Thanks for the feedback."
Long Zhi didn't respond. Instead, she unleashed.

A majestic, terrifying pressure exploded from her body as she tapped into her Half-step Nascent Soul cultivation. The winds howled, and ghostly dragon phantoms began to coil around her rising sword intent.
Zhang Xian flicked his wrist, tossing a sword wreathed in violent lightning toward her. "Take this. Your old blade is junk. With your base, you should be able to refine it while we fight."

Long Zhi caught the lightning-etched hilt without hesitation. She felt the raw power of the artifact and sent a mental transmission: The white mist erodes the spirit; the black mist corrupts the soul. Avoid them at all costs.
Zhang Xian nodded, his playful demeanor vanishing into a cold, calculating focus. "Go for the throat. I’ll keep you covered. If we see an opening, we destroy that puppet together."
"Agreed."
Long Zhi lunged, her new blade trailing a sky full of screaming thunder serpents.
