chapters.title: Chapter 145 Shearing the Immortal Sheep
paragraphs: Su Yunmiao’s avatar let out a sigh that seemed to carry the dust of a thousand years.
She pointed toward the withered old man sitting at the eye of the formation. His hair was white as crane feathers, his face youthful yet marred by the gray pallor of decay.

"That is Qin Mian, Supreme Elder of the Penglai Immortal Sect. He was the first to discover the encroaching traces of the Seven Emotions. To prevent them from ravaging the mortal world, he chose to feed himself to the demons. He forcibly merged their essence into his own body, acting as a living prison for over a millennium."

Her voice dropped a fraction. "But Elder Qin Mian’s lifespan is at its end. Once his Dao dissipates, the Entities will break their chains and seize his empty shell. A peak cultivator puppeted by cosmic malice will descend upon the Southern Region. It would take only a wave of its hand to erase nations."
Zhang Xian’s gaze shifted instinctively to Su Yunmiao’s true body, his eyes burning with a silent question: Why not the others? Why not you?
As if reading his thoughts, the avatar explained calmly. "Su Ling is a construct; a puppet body cannot house the Seven Emotions."

She gestured to the middle-aged man with the resolute jawline. "He is the current Sect Master. He attempted to shoulder Qin Mian’s burden years ago. The attempt nearly shattered his soul and drove him mad instantly. He has yet to fully recover."
Finally, she looked at her own meditating true body.

"As for me, I am already the jailer for another entity: [The Entity of Love]. Splitting my mind further is impossible. My cultivation is slightly inferior to Elder Qin Mian’s; I cannot suppress two at once. The final stray entity, [Obsession], required a new vessel."
She looked at the girl in the center.

"Lele has cultivated the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra to perfection. Her Dao Heart is flawless, empty, and clear. In the entire Southern Region, she is the only candidate capable of containing [Obsession]. When she learned the truth, she accepted the burden without hesitation."
Zhang Xian felt an invisible hand crush his heart. He stared at the frowning silhouette of his sister.
"And if... if she fails?"
"Then [Obsession] will devour her consciousness," Su Yunmiao said starkly. "She will no longer be Xingxiu. She will no longer be Lele. She will be a calamity wearing her face."
The air in Zhang Xian’s chest turned to lead. "How long?"

"It is impossible to say. [Obsession] has festered inside Qin Mian for centuries; it is ancient and powerful." Su Yunmiao shook her head. "Perhaps ten years. Perhaps fifty. During this time, her soul will be drowning in illusions constructed by the entity. She will see nothing of the outside world."

"We four must maintain the 'Four Symbols Absolute Seal' to nurture her spirit and hold the line. As she strengthens her will against the intruder, we will slowly lower the barriers... until she is strong enough to refine the entity herself. Only then can she leave seclusion."
Zhang Xian fell silent.
He looked at the girl who was mere yards away, yet separated from him by a chasm of duty and danger. He knew he had no right to object. She was saving the world.
But why did it have to be her?
After a long silence, he took a deep breath. He flipped his hand, and a device glowing with starlight appeared in his palm—the Earth-Grade ephemeral artifact, the [Void Breaking Shuttle].
He tapped the air, anchoring a spatial coordinate right there, inside the forbidden zone.
"Elder Su," Zhang Xian said, his voice heavy with steel. "If anything—anything at all—happens to Lele, notify me. I do not care if I am at the ends of the earth. I will come."
Su Yunmiao’s eyes widened slightly. To burn a priceless teleportation artifact just to set a marker? The sheer waste spoke volumes of his devotion.
Zhang Xian stared through the seven-colored barrier one last time. He etched the image of her furrowed brow into his memory.
"Let’s go," he finally said, turning away. "Take me back."
Back in the sunlit courtyard of the guest island, Zhang Xian took a moment to compose himself. Grief was useless; resources were power.
He retrieved an exquisite jade box from his storage.

"Elder Su," he said, offering the box with both hands. "I once promised Inspector Zhiyin that I would return your kindness twofold. You gifted me a celestial pill to save my life. Today, I return two. Thank you for the aid you have given me."
Su Yunmiao accepted the box politely. When she cracked the lid, however, the majestic surge of medicinal fragrance made her pupils contract.
"Primordial Creation Pills?"
Even with her thousands of years of cultivation, her voice cracked. She stared at the two pills, her eyes shimmering with disbelief.
"You... you actually possess such legends?"
Zhang Xian nodded, keeping his expression neutral. "I do."

Su Yunmiao inhaled sharply, struggling to suppress the shock. These were pills capable of rebuilding a shattered foundation, knitting together a broken Nascent Soul, or defying the heavens to reshape a cripple into a genius. They were priceless.

"I have ended up owing you a favor instead," she said gravely, closing the box. "When Lele succeeds and leaves seclusion, I will personally stand guard and ensure she consumes one of these to consolidate her foundation."
[Ding! Gift Successful. Triggering Critical Return: x200.]
[Received: Primordial Creation Pill x200.]
Perfect.
Zhang Xian suppressed a grin. Emotional moments were important, but so was shearing the sheep. He had just turned two pills into an arsenal capable of mass-producing geniuses.
He didn't stop there. He pulled out a brocade sack containing a Mid-Grade Spirit Treasure and several jars of Qingqiao Spirit Tea—tea so rich in energy it was practically liquid jade.
"And these are just small tokens of respect for you, Elder. Please, keep them. As for Lele..."
He paused, his tone shifting into the casual arrogance of a man whose wallet was bottomless.
"Don't worry about her resources. When she gets out, I'll personally outfit her with a full set of the best gear money can buy. I won't let her touch anything below Heaven Grade."
Su Yunmiao stood there, holding the Spirit Treasure and the tea, blinking.

She looked at the casual way he handed over fortunes. She heard the absolute certainty in his promise to "outfit" a cultivator like he was buying dolls for a child. Even as the Founder of a sect, she felt a momentary vertigo at his sheer financial horsepower.
This boy is... obscenely wealthy.
She cleared her throat, remembering her dignity. "Ahem. Very well."
[Ding! Gift Successful...]
Ignoring the system notifications cascading in his mind, Zhang Xian turned serious. "So, regarding the war in the Southern Region... Penglai is truly out of the fight?"
Su Yunmiao’s avatar nodded solemnly.

"We are. The [Obsession] and [Love] entities here have been growing for a millennium. They are catastrophic threats, far beyond the 'newborn' [Desire] entity roaming the Southern Region. We are holding a sword that hangs over the entire cultivation world."
She looked at him.
"Consider the war outside a trial for your generation. If you cannot handle a single infant Entity, you will have no hope against what lies here."

chapters.title: Chapter 146 I Hear You Have Many Red-Hued Confidantes
paragraphs: Su Yunmiao’s revelation hung in the air, heavy and intoxicating. Zhang Xian processed the implications for a moment before curiosity overwhelmed his caution.
"Dare I ask, Esteemed Elder," he ventured, his voice respectful but probing, "what realm have you actually reached?"

A mysterious, almost playful smile curved Su Yunmiao’s lips. "My realm? That is not for you to know yet. However..." She shifted, her posture radiating a casual arrogance that felt as natural as breathing. "I heard you offended the Guiyuan Sect of the Central Continent? Do not lose sleep over it. If we are debating who truly sits at the apex of this world, Song Taichu is still waiting for his turn."
Zhang Xian mentally cursed the riddle-speaking powerhouse but felt a mountain of weight lift off his shoulders. This woman didn't just ignore the Central Continent giants; she looked down on them.

The good news: he had hugged a thigh so thick it defied comprehension. The bad news: his [Teacher's Halo] was only a trial version. If he could have formally bowed and taken her as his Master right now, it would have been the ultimate shortcut to immortality.
As if reading his greed, Su Yunmiao produced several ancient jade boxes from her sleeve.

"It is poor form for an elder to accept gifts without reciprocation," she said, floating the boxes toward him. "I know your pockets are deep, and common treasures bore you. These are trinkets I have collected over the years. Consider them a meeting gift."
Zhang Xian caught them, his interest piqued. He popped the first lid. Inside sat two golden pills, their aroma so rich it cleared his mind instantly.

"The [Yellow Court Spirit Cleansing Pill]," Su Yunmiao explained. "Your spiritual roots are complete, but their quality is raw. These contain a trace of congenital essence. They will scrub the impurities from your foundation. Not as miraculous as your Creation Pills, but useful."
Useful? This is exactly what I needed.
Zhang Xian’s eyes lit up. He had been fretting over how to upgrade his newly acquired Five Elements roots. "Thank you, Ancestor! This is exactly what this disciple lacks."
He opened the second box. Inside lay a pair of warm, translucent white jade pendants, carved to resemble birds in flight.

"The [United Heart Winged Pendants]," she said. "A pair. When worn by two people, they create a bond that ignores almost all spatial seals. Activate one, and you will instantly teleport to the wearer of the other, regardless of distance."
She paused, a mischievous glint in her eyes. "However, they are single-use. The jade will shatter upon arrival."
She leaned forward slightly. "I hear you have... many red-hued confidantes? You will have to decide who is worthy of holding the other half."
Instant, unblockable teleportation.

Zhang Xian’s heart hammered. This was better than the [Void Breaking Shuttle], which cost blood essence to use. This was free. As for the single-use limit? He would just have the System clone it later.
He stashed the pendants with reverence. "Ancestor’s gifts are truly extraordinary. Disciple thanks you again."
Su Yunmiao looked at his genuine delight and felt her vanity stroked. "Go on, then. I have messaged Sect Leader Xing Jie. She will not trouble you."
"Disciple takes his leave." Zhang Xian bowed and summoned his vessel.
"Wait."
Su Yunmiao raised a hand. She pointed two fingers like a sword, gathering a speck of starlight at the tip. With a flick, she sent the light drifting into Zhang Xian’s chest.
It sank into him, washing over his body like cool water before vanishing into an invisible veil.

"I sensed someone using Heavenly Calculation techniques to hunt you," she said, her voice turning cold. "This [Star Concealment] mark will blind them. Unless their cultivation surpasses mine, they will find nothing but fog."
Zhang Xian stiffened. The [Demon Nest]. They were hunting him.
"Thank you for your protection, Ancestor."
This time, he didn't hesitate. He boarded his vessel, turning into a streak of prismatic light that tore through the sky, leaving the misty islands of Penglai behind.
He glanced back one last time, his gaze hardening.
Wait for me, Lele. I will be strong enough. I will be your shield.

The journey back to the Southern Capital took days of flight and teleportation transfers. When Zhang Xian finally stepped out of the array in the capital, the atmosphere hit him like a physical weight.
The usual roar of the imperial city was gone, replaced by a suffocating hush.
The streets were thin on crowds. Cultivators hurried with their heads down. The air tasted of panic.

Above, the massive dome of the Zhou Tian Grand Array hummed at full power, casting a shimmering light over the city. But the barrier brought no comfort. Everyone knew the truth now: the enemy was a Nascent Soul monster who could walk through walls and eat souls.
Rumors of the shadow assassin had spread like plague. The Grand Array was a majestic wall, but against a ghost, it was just decoration.

In the central plaza, Emperor Xia Xuanyin sat on a high platform, his golden robes stark against the gray mood. His voice boomed across the city via amplification arrays, issuing orders to sect cultivators and city guards. He projected strength, but the furrow in his brow betrayed his fear.
Perfected Being Shouheng led a team of array masters in a frantic effort to reinforce the city's nodes. Runes flashed and flickered as they worked, desperate to patch the unpatchable.
Every high-level cultivator knew it was theater. The demon’s corrupted life essence rotted array formations like acid. They were buying time, not safety.
Zhang Xian pulled his hood down and moved quickly through the anxious streets, heading straight for the Yunmiao Sect’s estate.
He pushed open the heavy doors of the courtyard.
"Zhang Xian!"
"Brother!"
Two figures blurred toward him.
Lin Yinyin and Li Fuxi stopped just short of tackling him. They had known he was alive via jade slip, but seeing him in the flesh—breathing, whole—was a different relief entirely.
Li Fuxi’s usually icy demeanor cracked. Her face flushed with a rare, sharp anger.
"Zhang Xian! You possess gall bigger than the heavens!"
She stepped forward, her chest heaving. "Do you have any idea what you walked into? That was a Nascent Soul entity! The apex of this world! You... you dared to chase it alone?"
Her eyes were wide, round with fear and fury. "If you ever do something that stupid again..."
Zhang Xian looked at her flushed face and felt a warm current in his chest. He held up his hands in surrender, grinning.
"Yes, yes, Master is right. This disciple was rash. I promise, never again."

sentences.text: Su Yunmiao’s revelation hung in the air, heavy and intoxicating.
Zhang Xian processed the implications for a moment before curiosity overwhelmed his caution.
"Dare I ask, Esteemed Elder," he ventured, his voice respectful but probing, "what realm have you actually reached?"
A mysterious, almost playful smile curved Su Yunmiao’s lips.
"My realm?
That is not for you to know yet.
However..." She shifted, her posture radiating a casual arrogance that felt as natural as breathing.
"I heard you offended the Guiyuan Sect of the Central Continent?
Do not lose sleep over it.
If we are debating who truly sits at the apex of this world, Song Taichu is still waiting for his turn."
Zhang Xian mentally cursed the riddle-speaking powerhouse but felt a mountain of weight lift off his shoulders.
This woman didn't just ignore the Central Continent giants; she looked down on them.
The good news: he had hugged a thigh so thick it defied comprehension.
The bad news: his [Teacher's Halo] was only a trial version.
If he could have formally bowed and taken her as his Master right now, it would have been the ultimate shortcut to immortality.
As if reading his greed, Su Yunmiao produced several ancient jade boxes from her sleeve.
"It is poor form for an elder to accept gifts without reciprocation," she said, floating the boxes toward him.
"I know your pockets are deep, and common treasures bore you.
These are trinkets I have collected over the years.
Consider them a meeting gift."
Zhang Xian caught them, his interest piqued.
He popped the first lid.
Inside sat two golden pills, their aroma so rich it cleared his mind instantly.
"The [Yellow Court Spirit Cleansing Pill]," Su Yunmiao explained.
"Your spiritual roots are complete, but their quality is raw.
These contain a trace of congenital essence.
They will scrub the impurities from your foundation.
Not as miraculous as your Creation Pills, but useful."
Useful?
This is exactly what I needed.
Zhang Xian’s eyes lit up.
He had been fretting over how to upgrade his newly acquired Five Elements roots.
"Thank you, Ancestor!
This is exactly what this disciple lacks."
He opened the second box.
Inside lay a pair of warm, translucent white jade pendants, carved to resemble birds in flight.
"The [United Heart Winged Pendants]," she said.
"A pair.
When worn by two people, they create a bond that ignores almost all spatial seals.
Activate one, and you will instantly teleport to the wearer of the other, regardless of distance."
She paused, a mischievous glint in her eyes.
"However, they are single-use.
The jade will shatter upon arrival."
She leaned forward slightly.
"I hear you have... many red-hued confidantes?
You will have to decide who is worthy of holding the other half."
Instant, unblockable teleportation.
Zhang Xian’s heart hammered.
This was better than the [Void Breaking Shuttle], which cost blood essence to use.
This was free.
As for the single-use limit?
He would just have the System clone it later.
He stashed the pendants with reverence.
"Ancestor’s gifts are truly extraordinary.
Disciple thanks you again."
Su Yunmiao looked at his genuine delight and felt her vanity stroked.
"Go on, then.
I have messaged Sect Leader Xing Jie.
She will not trouble you."
"Disciple takes his leave." Zhang Xian bowed and summoned his vessel.
"Wait."
Su Yunmiao raised a hand.
She pointed two fingers like a sword, gathering a speck of starlight at the tip.
With a flick, she sent the light drifting into Zhang Xian’s chest.
It sank into him, washing over his body like cool water before vanishing into an invisible veil.
"I sensed someone using Heavenly Calculation techniques to hunt you," she said, her voice turning cold.
"This [Star Concealment] mark will blind them.
Unless their cultivation surpasses mine, they will find nothing but fog."
Zhang Xian stiffened.
The [Demon Nest].
They were hunting him.
"Thank you for your protection, Ancestor."
This time, he didn't hesitate.
He boarded his vessel, turning into a streak of prismatic light that tore through the sky, leaving the misty islands of Penglai behind.
He glanced back one last time, his gaze hardening.
Wait for me, Lele.
I will be strong enough.
I will be your shield.
The journey back to the Southern Capital took days of flight and teleportation transfers.
When Zhang Xian finally stepped out of the array in the capital, the atmosphere hit him like a physical weight.
The usual roar of the imperial city was gone, replaced by a suffocating hush.
The streets were thin on crowds.
Cultivators hurried with their heads down.
The air tasted of panic.
Above, the massive dome of the Zhou Tian Grand Array hummed at full power, casting a shimmering light over the city.
But the barrier brought no comfort.
Everyone knew the truth now: the enemy was a Nascent Soul monster who could walk through walls and eat souls.
Rumors of the shadow assassin had spread like plague.
The Grand Array was a majestic wall, but against a ghost, it was just decoration.
In the central plaza, Emperor Xia Xuanyin sat on a high platform, his golden robes stark against the gray mood.
His voice boomed across the city via amplification arrays, issuing orders to sect cultivators and city guards.
He projected strength, but the furrow in his brow betrayed his fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 147 Brother, Are You Going to Favor the Next One Now
paragraphs: Lin Yinyin nodded beside him, her small face etched with worry. "Yes, Brother. Even if you're blessed with nine lives, you should think about me and Master. She's been so distracted these past few days she couldn't even meditate. She even ran into the Sect Master and got scolded for it."
"What? That old woman is here? And she dared to scold Master?" Zhang Xian bristled. He had never liked the Yunmiao Sect Master.

Li Fuxi quickly waved her hand. "It was nothing serious. With the demonic forces growing, Emperor Xia issued an emergency decree. The Ancestors of the major sects have emerged from seclusion to gather in the Southern Capital. The Sect Master came personally. Given the critical situation, her temper is naturally shorter."
She paused, her gaze searching his face. "During your trip to Penglai, did you see Elder Su and the Founder?"
Zhang Xian nodded. "I did. I learned quite a bit. I'll brief you on the details later, Master." He turned to Lin Yinyin. "Yinyin, come with me into my room first. I have something for you."
Lin Yinyin blinked, taken aback. Then, a furious blush spread across her cheeks. She shot a quick, guilty glance at her Master, lowered her head, and scurried after Zhang Xian into his room.

As soon as the door clicked shut, Lin Yinyin looked up with wide, watery eyes. "B-Brother, this isn't very appropriate, is it? It's the middle of the day! And besides, Master... she's waiting right outside." Her gaze darted around, a perfect picture of conflicted shyness and anticipation.
Thwack!
Zhang Xian flicked her forehead.
"Ow!" Lin Yinyin clutched her head, pouting. "Why do you always hit me?!"

"What kind of nonsense is rattling around in that brain of yours?" Zhang Xian feigned a stern scowl. "Have you been cultivating diligently? How much has your cultivation improved? Why are you still at the third level of the Golden Core? Look at me—I'm already at the fourth level, pushing for the fifth! You have a legendary Heavenly Spirit Root! Have you been slacking off again?"

Lin Yinyin's little mouth formed a perfect 'O', her eyes shimmering with instant tears. "Wah... Brother, you big scoundrel! I broke through the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra for you, and my cultivation regressed two whole levels! I barely recovered, and instead of pitying me, you complain I'm too slow!"
She sniffled loudly. "Besides, I saw your aptitude was... well, average before, so I didn't dare cultivate too hard. I was afraid of hurting your fragile self-esteem!"
"And now look at you! You get powerful, chase the number one beauty of the Southern Region, and even snatch up my Master! Now you start picking on me? Are you looking for an excuse to dump me?"
Zhang Xian felt his eyelid twitch. Faced with this masterful display of Green Tea logic, he sighed in defeat.
"Alright, alright. I'm just worried about you. I'm a prime target for the demons now. If they can't get to me, they might come for you. I want you strong enough to survive."
Instantly, the storm clouds vanished. A brilliant smile bloomed on Lin Yinyin's face as she threw herself at his arm, hugging it tight. "I'm not afraid. I have Brother to protect me."
Amused and exasperated by her shapeshifting mood, Zhang Xian ruffled her hair. He took out one of the [United Heart Winged Pendants] and pressed it into her palm.
"Keep this safe. Wear it always. If you are ever in danger, activate it immediately, and you will instantly teleport to my side."
Lin Yinyin turned the warm jade over in her hands. She could feel the protective intent radiating from it. Her heart swelled with sweetness.
See? I'm still the most important one.
Overjoyed, she stood on her tiptoes. Mwah! She planted a quick kiss on his cheek.
[Ding! Gift Successful. Return Triggered: United Heart Winged Pendant x100.]
Jackpot.
Zhang Xian smiled. "Open your mouth."
Lin Yinyin obediently opened up, and Zhang Xian popped a [Yellow Court Spirit Cleansing Pill] onto her tongue.
She swallowed it.
The room fell silent.
Several breaths passed. No spiritual light. No aura spike. And most importantly, no system notification.
Zhang Xian’s smile froze.
Damn it. A dud.
He realized his mistake instantly. Yinyin already possessed a top-tier Heavenly Spirit Root. You can't scrub a diamond cleaner than it already is. The pill did absolutely nothing.
That was a priceless pill... wasted.
But looking at Lin Yinyin's innocent, trusting eyes, he couldn't show his pain. He coughed, pretending nothing was wrong, and pulled out a stack of high-grade talismans and spirit stones.
"Take these too. For emergencies."
Lin Yinyin beamed and swept the loot into her storage ring. Finally, the pleasant Ding! of the return notification rang in Zhang Xian's mind, soothing his wounded wallet.
"Alright, Yinyin. Let's head out."
"Huh? Finished favoring your concubine already?" Lin Yinyin blinked innocently. "Brother, are you going to favor the next one now? Master is just next door.
Zhang Xian choked on his own breath. He raised a hand to smack her again, but she giggled, shoved the door open, and sprinted back to her own room before he could retaliate.
Zhang Xian took a moment to compose himself in the hallway. He smoothed his robes, steadied his breathing, and gently knocked on Li Fuxi's door.
"Come in."
Her voice was calm. Too calm.
Zhang Xian entered. Li Fuxi sat upright on the bench by the window, the very picture of icy composure. But her hands, resting on her knees, were curled into tight fists. Her posture was rigid.
Seeing her trying so hard to be the dignified Master, Zhang Xian’s mischievous streak flared up again.
He sauntered forward, dropping his voice to a low, magnetic register.
"Fuxi..."
Li Fuxi shuddered visibly at the intimacy. Goosebumps rose on her pale neck. She scooted away from him on the bench, stammering. "Who... who allowed you to be so... so presumptuous?"
But her scolding died in her throat when she met his burning gaze. Overwhelmed, she looked away, coughing to cover her flush.
"Y-you saw the Founder at Penglai? Did she have instructions for you?"
Zhang Xian sat down next to her, encroaching on her personal space. "Yes. The Founder was very kind. She praised my aptitude as outstanding and said my future is limitless."
Li Fuxi shot him a sideways glance that clearly screamed: I'd believe that when pigs fly.
"Stop speaking nonsense. The Founder is a supreme being; why would she flatter a junior like you?"
"Then why else would she bestow the precious [Primordial Creation Pills] upon me?"
Zhang Xian pulled out another pair of [United Heart Winged Pendants]. Ignoring her attempt to lean away, he reached out, took her left hand firmly in his, and pressed the jade into her warm palm.
"Master," he said softly. "This is for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 148 In Short, Profound Regret
paragraphs: Zhang Xian effortlessly recited the user manual for the [United Heart Winged Pendant]. Li Fuxi gazed down at the exquisite jade carving in her palm, her heart flooding with a warmth she hadn't felt in centuries.
As expected. Zhang Xian cares about me the most.
Her lips quirked up in a rare, genuine smile.
[Ding! Gift Successful.]
Zhang Xian caught the smile and grinned. He immediately produced a golden pill from his sleeve. "And this."
"What is it?"
"A gift from the Founder," he lied smoothly. "The [Yellow Court Spirit Cleansing Pill]. It purifies spiritual roots and unlocks potential. It won't conflict with any previous elixirs you've taken."

Hearing the pill's function, Li Fuxi immediately tried to push it back into his hand. "No. Such a divine treasure is wasted on me. You possess all five elements now, and your foundation is critical. This pill could elevate your potential to another level!"
Zhang Xian didn't let her refuse. He caught her hand, his thumb brushing her skin, his voice dropping into a doting purr.
"Master, do you still underestimate my treasury? I have plenty."

He leaned in, his warm breath ghosting over the shell of her ear. "I intend to nurture my Fuxi Master into the Southern Region's first dual Heavenly Spirit Root cultivator in history. I won't accept anything less."
Dual Heavenly Spirit Root...
The concept was staggering enough to make her head spin, but the phrase "my Fuxi Master" was the real blow. Her mind went fuzzy, her heart fluttering so wildly she forgot to pull her hand away.
Zhang Xian saw the haze in her eyes. He seized the moment, bringing the golden pill to her lips.
Li Fuxi's mental defenses had already crumbled. She stopped resisting, her lips parting slightly to accept the offering. She swallowed it with a shy obedience that made Zhang Xian's pulse jump.
[Ding! Gift Successful. Triggered Return: Yellow Court Spirit Cleansing Pill x100.]
Jackpot.
[Yellow Court Spirit Cleansing Pill: Epic-Grade. Massively enhances spirit root quality. Diminishing returns with repeated use.]
Boom!

A surge of pure, torrential medicinal power exploded in Li Fuxi's dantian. She gasped as she felt her Metal and Water spiritual roots—already top-tier—shudder and clarify, shedding invisible impurities to become crystalline and flawless.
She looked at Zhang Xian with shock, gratitude, and a swirling mist of affection.
Zhang Xian acted as if he expected nothing less. He produced a second pill from his inventory. "Again."
Li Fuxi was numb to the shock of his wealth now. She swallowed the second pill.
Then the third.
[Ding! Current Luck Value: 87.]
Feeling the unprecedented purity of her own spiritual power, Li Fuxi looked up at him. Her eyes were wet. She was an introverted woman, bad at words, but the dam finally broke.
"Zhang Xian... thank you," she whispered, her voice trembling. "Since... since my Master and Senior Brothers passed... it has been a long time since anyone was this good to me."
The vulnerability in her voice was the final straw.
A cold beauty with teary eyes, confessing her loneliness? It was a lethal combination. Zhang Xian felt a fire roar to life in his chest. Restraint was no longer an option.
He stepped forward. Before she could react, one arm snaked around her waist, pulling her flush against him. His other hand cupped her chin, tilting her face up.
He kissed her. Hard.
"Mmph!"

Li Fuxi’s eyes went wide. Her mind blanked out completely. She was enveloped in his scent, overwhelmed by the sudden, aggressive dominance of his embrace. She instinctively put her hands on his chest to push him away, but her strength had evaporated.
Under the assault of his kiss, her body betrayed her, turning soft and pliable in his arms. The world blurred until there was only the heat of his mouth and the thunder of her own heart.
The kiss deepened. His hands grew bolder.
Rip.
A soft sound echoed as the silver-white Daoist robe of the Divine Inspector slid from her shoulders, pooling on the floor.
The sudden coolness on her skin hit Li Fuxi like a bucket of ice water.
Shame flooded her system. She snapped out of the trance, her eyes flying open to see the raw hunger in Zhang Xian’s gaze. Panic seized her. She pushed at him, her voice cracking.
"N-no! Zhang Xian! Stop! I... I'm not ready!"
But Zhang Xian was an arrow already loosed from the bow string. Her weak protests sounded less like refusal and more like encouragement.
He didn't stop. He swept her up in a bridal carry, striding toward the bed with fire in his eyes.
"Zhang Xian! You scoundrel! Put me down!" Li Fuxi cried, tears of panic welling in her eyes.
He reached the bed. He lowered her down.
HUMMM—!
A violent, catastrophic aura erupted from Li Fuxi’s body.

There was no warning. A shockwave of pure spiritual pressure detonated in the room, blasting outward with hurricane force. Zhang Xian, caught completely off guard, was thrown backward, stumbling several steps before he could stabilize himself.
On the bed, Li Fuxi collapsed against the pillows. Her face was flushed scarlet, her hair wild, her clothes half-undone... but the air around her was twisting and screaming with power.
She looked at him, mortified, frantic, and apologetic all at once.
"I'm sorry! I can't control it!" she wailed. "Wait—I... I'm breaking through!!"
Breaking through?
Zhang Xian blinked, dazed. Then he looked at the spiraling energy vortex around her and realized what he had done.

She was already at the peak of the Golden Core seventh stage. He had just force-fed her three legendary cleansing pills. Her potential had been scrubbed clean, her channels widened, her bottlenecks shattered. The dam had burst.
She wasn't just breaking through; she was exploding into the eighth stage.
Are you kidding me? NOW?!

Zhang Xian stared at the beautiful, disheveled woman on the bed. He felt an indescribable pressure building in his chest—the frustration of a man who had the arrow nocked, drawn, and aimed, only for the bow to snap in his hands.
Li Fuxi wanted to die. To break through in this specific situation? With her clothes half off?

She saw the frustration on his face and felt her face burn hot enough to cook an egg. Using the last of her willpower, she grabbed the quilt and pulled it over her exposed shoulders, her voice thick with embarrassment.
"You... you have to get out! Go!"
Zhang Xian let out a long, tortured sigh. He looked at her one last time, grit his teeth, and let reason win.
He turned and walked out of the room.
Regret.
In short, profound regret. If he had known this would happen, he would have fed her the pills after.

Boom!
A surge of pure, torrential medicinal power exploded in Li Fuxi's dantian.
She gasped as she felt her Metal and Water spiritual roots—already top-tier—shudder and clarify, shedding invisible impurities to become crystalline and flawless.
She looked at Zhang Xian with shock, gratitude, and a swirling mist of affection.
Zhang Xian acted as if he expected nothing less.
He produced a second pill from his inventory.
"Again."
Li Fuxi was numb to the shock of his wealth now.
She swallowed the second pill.
Then the third.
[Ding!
Current Luck Value: 87.]
Feeling the unprecedented purity of her own spiritual power, Li Fuxi looked up at him.
Her eyes were wet.
She was an introverted woman, bad at words, but the dam finally broke.
"Zhang Xian... thank you," she whispered, her voice trembling.
"Since... since my Master and Senior Brothers passed... it has been a long time since anyone was this good to me."
The vulnerability in her voice was the final straw.
A cold beauty with teary eyes, confessing her loneliness?
It was a lethal combination.
Zhang Xian felt a fire roar to life in his chest.
Restraint was no longer an option.
He stepped forward.
Before she could react, one arm snaked around her waist, pulling her flush against him.
His other hand cupped her chin, tilting her face up.
He kissed her.
Hard.
"Mmph!"
Li Fuxi’s eyes went wide.
Her mind blanked out completely.
She was enveloped in his scent, overwhelmed by the sudden, aggressive dominance of his embrace.
She instinctively put her hands on his chest to push him away, but her strength had evaporated.
Under the assault of his kiss, her body betrayed her, turning soft and pliable in his arms.
The world blurred until there was only the heat of his mouth and the thunder of her own heart.
The kiss deepened.
His hands grew bolder.
Rip.
A soft sound echoed as the silver-white Daoist robe of the Divine Inspector slid from her shoulders, pooling on the floor.
The sudden coolness on her skin hit Li Fuxi like a bucket of ice water.
Shame flooded her system.
She snapped out of the trance, her eyes flying open to see the raw hunger in Zhang Xian’s gaze.
Panic seized her.
She pushed at him, her voice cracking.
"N-no!
Zhang Xian!
Stop!
I'm not ready!"
But Zhang Xian was an arrow already loosed from the bow string.
Her weak protests sounded less like refusal and more like encouragement.
He didn't stop.
He swept her up in a bridal carry, striding toward the bed with fire in his eyes.
"Zhang Xian!
You scoundrel!
Put me down!" Li Fuxi cried, tears of panic welling in her eyes.
He reached the bed.
He lowered her down.
HUMMM—!
A violent, catastrophic aura erupted from Li Fuxi’s body.
There was no warning.
A shockwave of pure spiritual pressure detonated in the room, blasting outward with hurricane force.
Zhang Xian, caught completely off guard, was thrown backward, stumbling several steps before he could stabilize himself.
On the bed, Li Fuxi collapsed against the pillows.
Her face was flushed scarlet, her hair wild, her clothes half-undone... but the air around her was twisting and screaming with power.
She looked at him, mortified, frantic, and apologetic all at once.
"I'm sorry!
I can't control it!" she wailed.
"Wait—I...
I'm breaking through!!"
Breaking through?
Zhang Xian blinked, dazed.
Then he looked at the spiraling energy vortex around her and realized what he had done.
She was already at the peak of the Golden Core seventh stage.
He had just force-fed her three legendary cleansing pills.
Her potential had been scrubbed clean, her channels widened, her bottlenecks shattered.
The dam had burst.
She wasn't just breaking through; she was exploding into the eighth stage.
Are you kidding me?
NOW?!
Zhang Xian stared at the beautiful, disheveled woman on the bed.
He felt an indescribable pressure building in his chest—the frustration of a man who had the arrow nocked, drawn, and aimed, only for the bow to snap in his hands.
Li Fuxi wanted to die.
To break through in this specific situation?
With her clothes half off?
She saw the frustration on his face and felt her face burn hot enough to cook an egg.
Using the last of her willpower, she grabbed the quilt and pulled it over her exposed shoulders, her voice thick with embarrassment.
"You... you have to get out!
Go!"
Zhang Xian let out a long, tortured sigh.
He looked at her one last time, grit his teeth, and let reason win.
He turned and walked out of the room.
Regret.
In short, profound regret.
If he had known this would happen, he would have fed her the pills after.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 Yinyin is Still the Most Considerate
paragraphs: Zhang Xian stepped into the hallway, only to spot a head popping out from the room next door. Lin Yinyin was eavesdropping.
Seeing Zhang Xian storm out with a face full of unreleased frustration, she froze for a split second. Then, a look of pure, malicious glee lit up her features.
"Hehe! Suffer!"
She stuck out her tongue, made a grotesque face, and—SLAM!—shut her door right in his face.
Zhang Xian stood alone in the empty corridor, the silence ringing in his ears. He looked at the closed door, then down at himself.
The well was right there. The water was sweet. He was dying of thirst. And someone had just welded the lid shut.
He sighed, shaking his head with a bitter smile, and shuffled back into his own room.

He plopped onto the cold meditation cushion, but the frustration wouldn't settle. The more he thought about it, the more shortchanged he felt. In a fit of pique, he pulled out a bottle of [Yellow Court Spirit Cleansing Pills] from his inventory.
"Fine! You won't let me release energy? I'll stuff more in!"
He dumped a handful of the legendary pills into his mouth like they were cheap peanuts.
"Eat! Eat! Let's see if I can't break through too!"
He chewed aggressively, swallowing the priceless medicine with pure spite. It took a long time for his temper to cool enough for him to actually circulate his Qi and refine the medicinal power.
By evening, Zhang Xian opened his eyes.

He hadn't broken through a realm, but the results were terrifying. His Wood Spirit Root had evolved to Supreme Grade. His Metal and Water roots, boosted by both the pills and his [Prodigious Disciple Halo], were now High Grade. Even his neglected Fire and Earth roots had climbed to Mid Grade.
In terms of raw talent, he was now a peerless genius.

He walked out of his room, feeling refreshed. He glanced at Li Fuxi's door—still tightly shut. She had just broken through to the eighth stage of the Golden Core; she would likely be stabilizing her foundation for days.
You escaped this time, Master, he thought with a grin. But you won't be so lucky next time.
Then, he heard a soft creak.
Lin Yinyin's door opened just a crack.
A smile touched Zhang Xian's lips. Yinyin is still the most considerate, thoughtful girl.
He straightened his sleeves and strode toward the crack in the door.
A moment later, Lin Yinyin's "scandalized" cry echoed from inside.
"How dare you! You audacious, rebellious disciple! What are you doing to your Master? Mmmph—"
BANG! The door slammed shut again.
The next morning, Zhang Xian was vibrated awake by his jade slip.
He groggily scanned the messages with his spiritual sense and chuckled. They were all from Perfected Being Wang Ya, sent with increasing desperation.
[Last Night]: Zhang Xian? You're back? I heard you met the Founder. Come to the Palace Hall when you can. Urgent matters.
[One Hour Later]: Did you get this? The Sect Master is here too. She is asking for you by name.
[Just Now]: Are you awake?! The Sect Master's face is green. She looks like she’s going to explode.
Zhang Xian laughed. Last night’s "battle" had been intense; checking messages was the last thing on his mind.
He typed a quick reply: [On my way.]

He looked down. Lin Yinyin was curled up in his arms, a satisfied smile still lingering on her lips. His heart melted a little. He carefully extracted his arm, dressed silently, and slipped out of the room.
The moment the door clicked shut, the "sleeping" Lin Yinyin snapped her eyes open. There was no drowsiness in them—only cunning triumph.
"Heh. Still wrapped around my finger."
She clenched a small fist, her expression hardening.
"No, I can't get complacent. Brother is shining too bright now. The moths and vixens will only multiply. I have to cultivate harder. I cannot fall behind. I will not lose to some random fox spirit!"
She sat up, threw a handful of spirit stones into a formation array, and immediately dropped into a deep cultivation trance.
When Zhang Xian strolled into the Imperial Palace Hall, looking refreshed and annoyingly cheerful, the room was already packed.
Emperor Xia Xuanyin stood before a massive tactical map, muttering low instructions to Perfected Being Shouheng. When he saw Zhang Xian, his face brightened. "Zhang Xian! Good timing. Come, join us."
Zhang Xian scanned the room. Aside from Wang Ya and Inspector Zhiyin, there were new heavyweights present.

Long Zhi stood near the front, her white robes pristine, her dragon aura sharper than a blade. Beside her was an ancient man with skin like weathered bark—Perfected Being Qingshi, the Supreme Elder of the Spirit Ruins Sword Sect.
Two elderly monks in golden kasayas sat in meditation—guardians from the Mountain Zen Monastery.

It was a gathering of titans. Excluding the Penglai forces, the Southern Region’s entire Nascent Soul lineup was here: The Emperor, Qingshi, Long Zhi, the two Monks, and Zhiyin. Six against the enemy's two known entities.
On paper, they had the advantage. In reality, everyone knew the enemy was a ghost in the fog.
Zhang Xian’s gaze finally landed on Sect Master Xing Jie. Her face was frosted over with enough ice to freeze a lake.
He ignored her completely. He walked past her without even a nod and took the empty seat next to Wang Ya.
"Zhang Xian!" Xing Jie’s voice snapped like a whip. "You returned yesterday. I summoned you multiple times. Why are you late?"
Zhang Xian picked at his ear. "Travel fatigue. I slept in."
"You—!" Xing Jie choked.
Wang Ya jumped in to play peacemaker. "Zhang Xian! Good to see you. Did you meet Elder Su and the Founder? Are they well?"
"I met them," Zhang Xian said, leaning back. "They're busy saving the world, so they can't come. But they sent their regards and expressed confidence that we can handle a few stray demons."
"Saving the world?" Perfected Being Qingshi frowned. "What could be more important than a demonic invasion? Is Yunmiao Sect trying to avoid the war?"
Emperor Xia raised a hand. "Peace. Supreme Elder Su messaged me yesterday. Penglai is currently suppressing two ancient entities..."
He quickly briefed the room on the "Seven Emotions" calamity.
The hall fell silent. The air grew heavy.

"So," the Emperor concluded grimly. "According to Su Yunmiao, the [Entity of Desire] grows stronger with time. I fought its shadow puppet; its power is already Nascent Soul level. The second entity is likely Nascent Soul Second Stage. If we let them feed, if they break through to the Mid-Stage... the Southern Region is finished."

Nearby, General Han Yichen slammed his fist onto the table. "The worst part is Baoqing Workshop! The moment they smelled trouble, they pulled all their core forces back to the Central Continent. They left nothing but low-level clerks and demanded we protect their assets! Cowardly profiteers!"

chapters.title: Chapter 150 Zhang’s Grand Gift Package
paragraphs: Xia Xuanyin shook his head, a look of helpless exhaustion on his face as the echoes of Han Yichen’s tirade faded.

"Enough," the Emperor said, his voice weary. "The cultivators of the Baoqing Workshop who chose to remain are still citizens of our Southern Region. We cannot blame the weak for fleeing. Besides, news from the Central Continent is grim; the chaos caused by the Entities of the Seven Emotions is spreading there as well. The Guiyuan Sect has already formally refused our request for aid."
He paused, shifting the tone of the room. "However, the Heavenly Abyss Alliance has agreed to intervene. They are dispatching a Grandmaster of Divination, a Nascent Soul expert, to assist us."

The Heavenly Abyss Alliance. Along with the Guiyuan Sect, they were one of the two titans of the Central Continent. Unlike the rigid hierarchy of the Guiyuan Sect, the Alliance had started as a loose coalition of rogue cultivators and smaller sects, slowly growing into a behemoth that shattered the Guiyuan Sect’s monopoly.

An old monk from the Mountain Zen Monastery pressed his palms together. "Amitabha. That the Heavenly Abyss Alliance is willing to extend a hand is a great fortune for the Southern Region. I have heard that Your Majesty’s son is a leading figure among the Alliance’s younger generation?"

At the mention of his son, a genuine smile broke through Xia Xuanyin’s stony mask. "Indeed. My unworthy son, Xia Chengyan, has fortunately been ranked among the Central Continent’s 'Ten Outstanding Youths.' He will personally escort the Grandmaster here."
Listening from the sidelines, Zhang Xian’s mouth twitched.
Ten Outstanding Youths?
It sounded like some sort of corporate '30 Under 30' list. Were they going to give him a plaque and a LinkedIn badge, too?

Elder Qing Shi stroked his long beard, nodding. "This is excellent news. If this Grandmaster can divine the location of the Demon Nest, this old man swears to cut it down with a single strike. We will sever this trouble at the root!"
The atmosphere seemed to be lifting, but then a sharp voice cut through the optimism.
"Zhang Xian!"

Sect Master Xing Jie turned her glare upon him. "You claimed to hail from a secluded secret realm. Now that the Southern Region stands on the precipice of annihilation, does the powerful family behind you intend to sit back and watch us die?"
Is this old woman senile?

Zhang Xian felt a surge of irritation. Why did she always target him? Rumor had it that Xing Jie had been dumped by a scoundrel in her youth, a trauma that made her exceptionally compatible with the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra. Unfortunately, after centuries of failing to break through to the Nascent Soul stage, her bitterness had calcified into pure spite.

He didn't bother with polite honorifics. "Sect Master, where exactly have I offended you? You seem determined to find fault with everything I do. What, are you suddenly concerned about my family elders?"
"Impudence!" Xing Jie’s face flushed red. "You are a calamity upon our sect! You bewitched Lin Yinyin and deceived Li Fuxi, driving her to use the 'Jade Shattering' technique!"

Her voice rose to a shrill scream. "Do you understand what that means? She didn't just break a bone; she shattered her jade! She destroyed her own foundation, sacrificing her future cultivation because of your influence! I don't know what demonic sorcery you use to twist minds, but while the Patriarch may tolerate you, I will not!"
"You dare bring my Master into this?" Zhang Xian shot to his feet, eyes cold.
Before spiritual energy could flare, a gentle but immovable force pressed down on Zhang Xian’s shoulder. Master Zhiyin didn't look up, but his spiritual pressure kept Zhang Xian seated.
"Zhang Xian," Zhiyin said softly. "This is an internal matter of the Yunmiao Sect. We will discuss it after the council concludes."
Emperor Xia Xuanyin quickly stepped in to smooth things over. "Please, everyone. The enemy is at the gates. We must be in the same boat, crossing the storm together.

Zhang Xian forced his anger down. If not for the presence of his martial uncles and the Emperor, he would have already flipped the table. A Half-Step Nascent Soul cultivator? He had killed things scarier than her before breakfast.
He swept his gaze across the room, noticing Long Zhi watching him with a thoughtful expression. Her stare reminded him of a boast he had made earlier—something about arming the righteous forces.
Fine. If you want a show, I’ll give you a show.

"Your Majesty," Zhang Xian said, his voice projecting clearly across the hall. "In this time of crisis, I, Zhang Xian, am willing to privately sponsor a shipment of military-grade supplies. Perhaps we could move to the Imperial Study later for a detailed discussion?"
Xia Xuanyin assumed the young man was merely trying to save face after the scolding. He nodded casually. "Very well."
After the council dispersed, Xia Xuanyin led Zhang Xian to the Imperial Study.
"Young friend Zhang," the Emperor said, his tone kind but patronizing, like an elder indulging a child. "Let us discuss this contribution you mentioned."
Zhang Xian nodded, then turned to the side. "Head Seat Wang Ya, would you mind joining us as a witness? I’d hate for anyone to accuse me of hoarding resources while the world burns."
Wang Ya gave a wry smile. "Very well. I shall shamelessly tag along."
The three men entered the study and took their seats. Zhang Xian didn't waste time with pleasantries. He stood in the center of the room and waved his hand.
Whoosh.
Space distorted. Dozens of jade chests and heavy iron-bound boxes materialized, slamming onto the floor with heavy thuds. They filled the open space of the study instantly.
Xia Xuanyin maintained a polite smile, but as Zhang Xian began flicking the latches open, the Emperor’s expression froze.
Box One: Packed to the brim with top-grade magical artifacts. Blades, spears, halberds—cold steel shimmering with lethal enchantments.
Box Two: A chaotic mountain of talismans. Earth, Fire, Wind, Thunder. The sheer density of trapped elemental energy made the air crackle.
Box Three: Hundreds of pill bottles, neatly labeled. Foundation Establishment Pills, Golden Core Nurturing Pills, Spirit Recovery Pills. Enough medicine to sustain an army for a year.
Boxes Four through Ten:

When the lids were thrown back, the room was bathed in a blinding prismatic glow. Ten crates filled with Top-Grade Spirit Stones. The spiritual pressure in the room spiked so drastically that the wooden furniture began to groan.
Xia Xuanyin’s breath hitched. His eyes bulged.
But Zhang Xian wasn't finished.
He produced several smaller, intricately carved jade cases. He opened them one by one.

The rich, complex fragrance of Nascent Formation Pills wafted out, instantly clearing the minds of everyone in the room. Beside them lay stalks of Ascension Grass, their medicinal potency causing the surrounding qi to swirl in visible eddies. And finally, dozens of Low-Grade Spirit Treasures—actual Spirit Treasures—lay piled like common vegetables.
Xia Xuanyin and Wang Ya sat petrified. Their jaws hung slightly loose. They looked less like the supreme leaders of the Southern Region and more like peasants witnessing a miracle.
Watching their brains short-circuit, Zhang Xian felt a profound sense of satisfaction. This is the power of a whale.
"My abilities are limited," Zhang Xian said with a modest sigh, gesturing to the dragon's hoard on the floor. "I can only provide these strategic supplies as a small token of my regard."

"Th-These... are all for us?" Xia Xuanyin’s voice trembled. He pointed a shaking finger at the Spirit Treasures. These items alone were worth more than the entire liquid assets of the Imperial Treasury.

"Of course," Zhang Xian grinned. "Distributing them is Your Majesty's headache. I only have one condition: the origin of these Earth-Grade materials and Spirit Treasures must remain confidential. I prefer to keep a low profile."
"I understand," Xia Xuanyin inhaled deeply, regaining some composure. "‘A man's wealth is his own ruin if revealed.’ You have my word."
Zhang Xian thought for a moment, then reached into his robes and pulled out two ornate brocade boxes. He slid one to the Emperor and one to Wang Ya.
"You two bear the weight of the entire region on your shoulders. It is thankless work. This is a personal token of appreciation—call it the 'Zhang Grand Gift Package.' Please, don't refuse."
Grand Gift Package?
Wang Ya, still dazed, opened his box. He nearly blinded himself.

Inside, nestled in silk, were items that defied logic: Two Earth-Grade pills for purifying spiritual roots. A chaotic-patterned Lotus Seed capable of repairing damage to the Inner Core. Three Spirit Treasures—a sword, armor, and a pendant—forming a perfect offensive and defensive set. And... a bag of tea leaves?

"The pills will temper your roots," Zhang Xian explained casually, as if describing vitamins. "The Lotus Seed repairs foundation damage. The three Spirit Treasures are a matched set. As for the tea... it's a local specialty from my hometown. Drinking it provides a permanent boost to your Comprehension stat—ah, I mean, your enlightenment potential."
Wang Ya stared at the box.
His brain had stopped working.

Pills to upgrade talent? Two kinds? A matched set of Spirit Treasures? He had been a high-ranking elder of the Yunmiao Sect for centuries and didn't own a single Spirit Treasure, yet this kid just handed him three? And tea that improved comprehension?
Suddenly, Li Fuxi’s terrifying cultivation speed made perfect sense. She wasn't cultivating; she was pay-to-winning! She was practically eating heavenly treasures for breakfast!
Next to him, Xia Xuanyin was undergoing a similar existential crisis.
The Emperor stared fixedly at the pill in the center of his box. It was an Ascension Pill.
Years ago, he had nearly bankrupted the national treasury trying to win one of these at an auction hosted by Yang Poxiao, only to fail. It had been a regret that haunted him for years.
Now, that dream—that legendary pill—sat quietly in Zhang Xian’s "gift package," tossed out as casually as a party favor.
Xia Xuanyin looked at the pill, then at the smiling young man. For the first time in his life, the Emperor of the Southern Region felt like a country bumpkin who had never seen the world.

Rumor had it that Xing Jie had been dumped by a scoundrel in her youth, a trauma that made her exceptionally compatible with the Nine Turns Jade Condensation Sutra.
Unfortunately, after centuries of failing to break through to the Nascent Soul stage, her bitterness had calcified into pure spite.
He didn't bother with polite honorifics.
"Sect Master, where exactly have I offended you?
You seem determined to find fault with everything I do.
What, are you suddenly concerned about my family elders?"
"Impudence!" Xing Jie’s face flushed red.
"You are a calamity upon our sect!
You bewitched Lin Yinyin and deceived Li Fuxi, driving her to use the 'Jade Shattering' technique!"
Her voice rose to a shrill scream.
"Do you understand what that means?
She didn't just break a bone; she shattered her jade!
She destroyed her own foundation, sacrificing her future cultivation because of your influence!
I don't know what demonic sorcery you use to twist minds, but while the Patriarch may tolerate you, I will not!"
"You dare bring my Master into this?" Zhang Xian shot to his feet, eyes cold.
Before spiritual energy could flare, a gentle but immovable force pressed down on Zhang Xian’s shoulder.
Master Zhiyin didn't look up, but his spiritual pressure kept Zhang Xian seated.
"Zhang Xian," Zhiyin said softly.
"This is an internal matter of the Yunmiao Sect.
We will discuss it after the council concludes."
Emperor Xia Xuanyin quickly stepped in to smooth things over.
"Please, everyone.
The enemy is at the gates.
We must be in the same boat, crossing the storm together.
Zhang Xian forced his anger down.
If not for the presence of his martial uncles and the Emperor, he would have already flipped the table.
A Half-Step Nascent Soul cultivator?
He had killed things scarier than her before breakfast.
He swept his gaze across the room, noticing Long Zhi watching him with a thoughtful expression.
Her stare reminded him of a boast he had made earlier—something about arming the righteous forces.
Fine.
If you want a show, I’ll give you a show.
"Your Majesty," Zhang Xian said, his voice projecting clearly across the hall.
"In this time of crisis, I, Zhang Xian, am willing to privately sponsor a shipment of military-grade supplies.
Perhaps we could move to the Imperial Study later for a detailed discussion?"
Xia Xuanyin assumed the young man was merely trying to save face after the scolding.
He nodded casually.
"Very well."
After the council dispersed, Xia Xuanyin led Zhang Xian to the Imperial Study.
"Young friend Zhang," the Emperor said, his tone kind but patronizing, like an elder indulging a child.
"Let us discuss this contribution you mentioned."
Zhang Xian nodded, then turned to the side.
"Head Seat Wang Ya, would you mind joining us as a witness?
I’d hate for anyone to accuse me of hoarding resources while the world burns."
Wang Ya gave a wry smile.
"Very well.
I shall shamelessly tag along."
The three men entered the study and took their seats.
Zhang Xian didn't waste time with pleasantries.
He stood in the center of the room and waved his hand.
Whoosh.
Space distorted.
Dozens of jade chests and heavy iron-bound boxes materialized, slamming onto the floor with heavy thuds.
They filled the open space of the study instantly.
Xia Xuanyin maintained a polite smile, but as Zhang Xian began flicking the latches open, the Emperor’s expression froze.
Box One: Packed to the brim with top-grade magical artifacts.
Blades, spears, halberds—cold steel shimmering with lethal enchantments.
Box Two: A chaotic mountain of talismans.
Earth, Fire, Wind, Thunder.
The sheer density of trapped elemental energy made the air crackle.
Box Three: Hundreds of pill bottles, neatly labeled.
Foundation Establishment Pills, Golden Core Nurturing Pills, Spirit Recovery Pills.
Enough medicine to sustain an army for a year.
Boxes Four through Ten:
When the lids were thrown back, the room was bathed in a blinding prismatic glow.
Ten crates filled with Top-Grade Spirit Stones.
The spiritual pressure in the room spiked so drastically that the wooden furniture began to groan.
Xia Xuanyin’s breath hitched.
His eyes bulged.
But Zhang Xian wasn't finished.
He produced several smaller, intricately carved jade cases.
He opened them one by one.
The rich, complex fragrance of Nascent Formation Pills wafted out, instantly clearing the minds of everyone in the room.
Beside them lay stalks of Ascension Grass, their medicinal potency causing the surrounding qi to swirl in visible eddies.
And finally, dozens of Low-Grade Spirit Treasures—actual Spirit Treasures—lay piled like common vegetables.
Xia Xuanyin and Wang Ya sat petrified.
Their jaws hung slightly loose.
They looked less like the supreme leaders of the Southern Region and more like peasants witnessing a miracle.
Watching their brains short-circuit, Zhang Xian felt a profound sense of satisfaction.
This is the power of a whale.
"My abilities are limited," Zhang Xian said with a modest sigh, gesturing to the dragon's hoard on the floor.
"I can only provide these strategic supplies as a small token of my regard."
"Th-These... are all for us?" Xia Xuanyin’s voice trembled.
He pointed a shaking finger at the Spirit Treasures.
These items alone were worth more than the entire liquid assets of the Imperial Treasury.
"Of course," Zhang Xian grinned.
"Distributing them is Your Majesty's headache.
I only have one condition: the origin of these Earth-Grade materials and Spirit Treasures must remain confidential.
I prefer to keep a low profile."
"I understand," Xia Xuanyin inhaled deeply, regaining some composure.
"‘A man's wealth is his own ruin if revealed.’ You have my word."
Zhang Xian thought for a moment, then reached into his robes and pulled out two ornate brocade boxes.
He slid one to the Emperor and one to Wang Ya.
"You two bear the weight of the entire region on your shoulders.
It is thankless work.
This is a personal token of appreciation—call it the 'Zhang Grand Gift Package.' Please, don't refuse."
Grand Gift Package?
Wang Ya, still dazed, opened his box.
He nearly blinded himself.
Inside, nestled in silk, were items that defied logic: Two Earth-Grade pills for purifying spiritual roots.
A chaotic-patterned Lotus Seed capable of repairing damage to the Inner Core.
Three Spirit Treasures—a sword, armor, and a pendant—forming a perfect offensive and defensive set.
And... a bag of tea leaves?
"The pills will temper your roots," Zhang Xian explained casually, as if describing vitamins.
"The Lotus Seed repairs foundation damage.
The three Spirit Treasures are a matched set.
As for the tea... it's a local specialty from my hometown.
Drinking it provides a permanent boost to your Comprehension stat—ah, I mean, your enlightenment potential."
Wang Ya stared at the box.
His brain had stopped working.
Pills to upgrade talent?
Two kinds?
A matched set of Spirit Treasures?
He had been a high-ranking elder of the Yunmiao Sect for centuries and didn't own a single Spirit Treasure, yet this kid just handed him three?
And tea that improved comprehension?
Suddenly, Li Fuxi’s terrifying cultivation speed made perfect sense.
She wasn't cultivating; she was pay-to-winning!
She was practically eating heavenly treasures for breakfast!
Next to him, Xia Xuanyin was undergoing a similar existential crisis.
The Emperor stared fixedly at the pill in the center of his box.
It was an Ascension Pill.
Years ago, he had nearly bankrupted the national treasury trying to win one of these at an auction hosted by Yang Poxiao, only to fail.
It had been a regret that haunted him for years.
Now, that dream—that legendary pill—sat quietly in Zhang Xian’s "gift package," tossed out as casually as a party favor.
Xia Xuanyin looked at the pill, then at the smiling young man.
For the first time in his life, the Emperor of the Southern Region felt like a country bumpkin who had never seen the world.
